tei:div.tei:p: mar snang zhing*/ skye ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba la sogs pa'i tshul du ma bstan pas gdul bya de dag gi don mdzad pa la sprul pa'i sku zhes brjod de

| de lta bu'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can la sangs rgyas zhes bya/ des rang gi thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin gzhan la bstan pas gzhan dag kyang*/ nges par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i thabs la theg pa chen po zhes bya/ de'ang bsdu na gnyis te/ lta ba rnam par dag pa stong pa nyid gtso bor ston pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum la sogs pa la zab mo'i mdo zhes bya/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang*/ sems can gyi las kyi tshul rgya chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang*/ phrin las rgya che bar gtso bor ston pa phal po che la sogs pa la rgya che ba'i mdo zhes bya/ theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad zab pa dang rgya che ba'i tshul gnyis su ma 'dus pa med/ de'ang gang zag so so'i nyams su blang bya ma yin par gang zag gcig gis nyams su blang bya yin/ nyams su len pa'i tshul yang | sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir bar shes nas/ de rnams sdug bsngal thams cad las bskyab pa'i don du rang gis sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs nas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par bya ba dang*/ de'i lam la slob par khas 'che ba'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa blangs nas/ rang gi sangs rgyas kyi chos thob pa'i don du/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang | gzhan smin par bya ba'i don du/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi don spyod du 'jug pa dang | rang gis kyang sems can de dag gi don du/ de dag dang mthun par spyod pa ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la ci nus su bslabs nas/ sa dang lam thams cad rim gyis bgrod de/

sngar bstan pa ltar sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can du 'tshang rgya ba yin/ cig car ba'i lam zhes gsungs pa ni/ drang ba'i don yin te | dgongs pa'i dgongs gzhi/ sngon yun ring por lam la sbyangs pa/ las kyi dbang gis tha mal du skyes nas/ bag chags sad ma nus pa 'ga' zhig la/ sangs rgyas sam dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis shin tu zab pa stong pa nyid kyi chos bstan pas bag chags sad nas/ de nyid du sems grol ba lta bu la dgongs pa yin | de ltar drang don gsungs pa'i dgos pa/ gang zag brtson 'grus chung shing le lo can 'ga' zhig sa dang lam rnams la bskal pa mang por bsgrub dgos na/ bdag cag gis mi nus pas chos la mi 'jug snyam du sems pa rnams la cig car grol ba'i sgo yang yod do/ /zhes bstan pas/ chos la 'jug par 'gyur la/ zhugs pa dang rim gyis bslab pas/ dka' ba dang*/ rgya che ba'i don la yang mi skrag par 'gyur ba yin no/ /dngos la gnod byed kyi tshad ma ni gal te cig car 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs yod na/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du tshogs bsags pa 'khrul par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i khyad par rgyu'i khyad par la mi ltos par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon yod | des na sems can thams cad cig car 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ gtan 'tshang mi rgya bar gsungs pa thams cad drang don yin pas na/ nges pa'i don du gzung bar mi bya'o/ /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshul ston pa de dag la lung gi chos zhes bya/ nyams su len pa'i rim pa de dag la sgrub pa'i chos zhes bya/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sems la yon tan skyes pa la rtogs pa'i chos zhes bya/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos de dag la chos dkon mchog ces brjod do/ /dge 'dun ni smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa tsam nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi khongs su 'du la/ sa dang po nas ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du 'gyur zhing*/

sa brgyad pa thob nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de de lta bu'i dkon mchog de dag kyang nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin/ 'jig rten la mtha' med/ 'jig rten la mtha' med pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas la mtha' med | sangs rgyas la mtha' med pa bzhin/ des gsungs pa'i chos la mtha' med | chos la mtha' med pa bzhin/ chos bsgrub pa'i dge 'dun la'ang mtha' med pas/ mtha' yas pa'-i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni yul yin no/ /ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la ston pa dang thob bya'i don du skyabs/ chos la lam dang bsgrub bya'i don du skyabs/ dge 'dun la grogs dang rtsa lag gi don du skyabs pa'o/ /yang dang po dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshig gi rjes su 'brangs nas skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ mos pa tsam yid la byed pa yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ de la goms shing 'dris par byas pas dkon mchog gsum la bdud bye ba brgyas kyang dbye bar mi nus shing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin dang*/ rang gi rang bzhin gnyis su med par shes pa chos nyid kyis thob pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba yin/ ji srid skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus ni/ rang gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba yin/ ji ltar bsgrub pa'i bslab bya ni | gsum ka'i thun mong gi bslab bya/ theg pa chen po ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa/ de la sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par nyan pa/ de'i don ji ltar nus pas bsgrub pa gsum yin/ so so'i bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa la ston par mi 'dzin/ chos la skyabs su song nas/ chos ma yin pa la lam du mi 'dzin/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas/ dge 'dun ma yin pa la grogs su mi 'dzin/ rtag tu de dag gi yon tan rjes su dran par byed pa'au/

/de ltar skyabs su song ba'i phan yon bdun te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dag par zhugs par 'gyur ba/ log par mos pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bsrabs pa/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba/ bsrung ba chen por 'gyur ba/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis phan 'dogs pa/ srid pa thams cad du dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral ba/ mthar thug rang nyid sangs rgyas nas chos bstan te/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bar 'gyur ba'o/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul gyi rnam par bzhag pa 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma dang*/ yon gyi bdag por gyur pa/ bo lod ces bya bas/ rgyang ring po nas bskul ba'i don du/ 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i nyi shu brgyad la/ yol gyi sa char sbyar nas bskur ba'o || || ༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi bslab bya ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + nyung bsdus ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo dang chos kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro yin pas/ de'i bslab bya la gnyis las/ thun mong gi bslab bya bzhi ni/ skyes bu dam pa dang 'grogs pa zhes bya ba/ theg pa chen po ston pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas mnyes par byed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos mnyan pa zhes bya ba bla ma de la sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos mnyan zhing (《 zha 》+ yid la bzung ba dang*/ tshul bzhin ) yid la byed pa zhes bya ba bdag dkon mchog gsum la bskyabs pa yin pas/ las ci rung rung byar mi nyan snyam du bsam pa'i dran pa dang*/ las ci byed pa thams cad kyi sngon du bdag gis ci zhig byed par 'gyur na snyam du shes par byas nas/ sdig pa'i las yin na mi byed pa dang*/ dge ba yin na 'bad pas sgrub par byed pa dran shes bzhin du ldan pa dang*/ chos bzhin du bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ spy-ir blang ba dang*/ dor ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin du byed cing*/

bye brag tu spyod lam thams cad dge bar 'gyur ba byed pa yin/ so so'i bslab bya ni | sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa la ston par mi 'dzin | chos la skyabs su song nas/ chos ma yin pa la lam du mi 'dzin/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas/ dge 'dun ma yin pa la grogs su mi 'dzin pa'o | | 'tshang rgya bar byed pa'i lam gyi dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems yin pas de'i bslab bya ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i skyon bsam pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis pha ma ma byas pa med pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag pas kyang ngan pa las byung na bdag gis sangs rgyas ci'i phyir mi thob snyam pa'i gzengs bstod pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis sdig pa mi byed cing*/ dbang med byas na bshags pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis dge ba la 'bad cing | gang byas pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo ba/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad brtag na rang bzhin med par shes shing mnyam par 'jog pa rnams yin no || || thabs bde zhing 'jug sla ba'i sgo gsang sngags yin zhing*/ de'i rtsa ba dbang bskur ba yin pas/ de'i bslab bya la/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la sdug byams dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la nges mi smad/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya | | bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis mi bya zhing*/ /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/

/chos nyid tshad ni mi bzung zhing*/ /dad ldan sems ni sun mi dbyung*/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsten par bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya | | bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ rgyun du longs spyod pa'i kha zas la kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan par byed pa dang*/ bye brag tu tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa la tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa yin/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rdo rje dril bu dang*/ dbu rgyan dang*/ bgrang phreng la sogs pa dam tshig gi rdzas rnams 'dzin pa yin/ bsgrub pa'i dam tshig lha'i rnal 'byor ni zhag phrug re re la thun bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis sam/ tha ma na'ang thun re ma chag par bsgom pa yin | bslab bya de dag dus rtag tu ma chag par byas na ji ltar 'gor yang*/ skye ba bcu drug las mi 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur bar sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs so/ /de ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi/ /bslab bya nyung 'dus gsal bar 'phags pa yis/ /bsdebs nas rgyal bu a rog che la 'bul/ /nyams su bzhes shig sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur ro | | lcags mo lug gi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig la shing kun gyi sa'i cha la sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab byed bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyan par grags pa sgra yi dpal dang ni/ /yon tan rmad byung don gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la 'di gsol lo | | gtsug lag gnyis kyi mchid ni snyan rgu zhig khyod kyi thugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ /sil snyan mkhan gyi glu dang sil snyan ltar/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis slar yang cis mi gleng*/ /thub pas mtha' yas gdul bya'i don slad du/ / chos kyi phung po bgrang yas gang gsungs pa/ /kun kyang nyams su blang bgyi 'ba' zhig ste/

/de yi tshul yang 'di ltar mkhyen par mdzod/ /ji ltar 'jigs dang ngo tshas bsdams pa'i mi/ /rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims las mi 'da' bar | | tshul bzhin gnas pa 'tshe med dpal 'phel zhing*/ /rgyal po las kyang bsngags pa thob pa ltar/ /thub pas dang po'i las can rjes gzung phyir/ /thun mong theg par rnam par bcas pa'i khrims/ /rang gis bsgrub par nus bzhin yul las ni/ /cho ga'i yan lag phun tshogs kyis blangs pa/ /mthong dang ma mthong srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /rnam par 'jigs dang pha rol gzigs pa yi | | 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi thugs kyis bas 'gyur zhes/ /ngo tshas bsdams te tshul bzhin bsrung bgyis na/ /mthong dang ma mthong srid pa'i bde ba dang*/ / rnam grol yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur la/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas 'gyur zhing*/ /sangs rgyas las kyang bsngags pa thob par 'gyur/ /srid gsum 'di dag sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang zhi ba tsam du zad/ / de phyir 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /smon pa snying rje'i yul du bltas nas des | | sdug bsngal med pas sdug bsngal kun sel dang*/ /bde chen brnyes pas bde ba kun stsol ba/ /sangs rgyas kho na yin zhing de yang ni/ /bdag 'dra ba las byung zhing de yi thabs/ /bsgrub par nus pa de slad bdag gis kyang*/ / sangs rgyas nges par thob par bya'o zhes/ /don gnyer mi zhum sgy-id lug med pa yi | | g.yo med byang chub sems mchog bsgom par bgyi/ /gang las 'das na dmyal bar bsreg 'gyur zhing*/ /de bsrungs na ni bde bas bde ba'i 'bras/ / rmad du byung ba 'phral du 'thob byed pa'i/ /dam tshig blangs nas srog bzhin gces par bsrung*/ /de ltar theg pa gsum gyi sdom pa gsum/ /rang gzhan don gyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /skye dang gnas dang 'phel ba'i rten lags pas/ / thog ma nyid du brtan par bgyid 'tshal lo/ /ngag tshig shin tu dri ma med pa dang | | tshad ma gnyis kyis kun nas nges pa dang*/

/mi 'gal ba dang thog mtha' bar dge ba'i/ /chos la chos kyi khyad par nges bgyis nas/ /gsungs pa po de mkhyen rab thogs med dang*/ /dpe mkhyud med par ston phyir brtse ldan dang | (《 zha 》+ de yi mi mthun phyogs kyi nyes spang pa ) /mthu chen brnyes par mkhyen nas sangs rgyas dang*/ /de yi rjes 'jug phyir dang de nyid dang*/ /rgyu mthun yon tan ldan dang 'dus pa'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi mchog dang spyod yul mthun pa yis/ / zhing gi dam par nges nas dge 'dun dang*/ /de dag nye bar ston dang mtshams sbyor dang*/ /rnam gsum yon tan cha mthun mnga' ba dang*/ /drin gyis bskyab par dgongs nas bla ma la/ /rtag bsten mi phyed dad pas bsgom par bgyi/ / rgyu dang ngo bo rgyun chags rang bzhin gyis/ /bdag rgyud sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang*/ /bral bar 'dod bzhin ma lus 'gro ba la'ang*/ /mtshungs 'dod mi 'phrogs snying rje chen po bsgom/ /byang chub mchog dang gzhan gyi don dang ni/ /gnas skabs don du gnyer bya'i dge ba yi/ /phan yon rjes su dran nas de bsgrub phyir/ /'dun pa drag pos de la yongs su sbyar/ /de ltar dad dang snying rje 'dun pa'i sems/ /las rnams kun gyi sngon 'gro lags pas na/ / dge ba'i dngos po cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /'di yis kun nas bslangs te bsgrub par bgyi/ /mdun du'am ni yang na rang gi lus/ /thub pa'i dbang po gzugs kyi skur blta zhing*/ /gnas ni sangs rgyas zhing dang skye 'gro kun/ / rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa dang*/ /dbang po lnga yi yul gyi longs spyod kun

| | mchod sprin rgya mtshos bdag gzhan mchod par bgyi/ /bla ma mchog dang ma lus rgyal ba kun/ /rnam pa dang ni phrin las ngo bo nyid/ /mtshungs shing gnyis su med par 'tshal bgyis nas/ /dus rnams kun tu mdun nam spyi gtsug gam/ /snying gi chu skyes dbus su bsam bgyis nas/ /gsol ba gdab pa'am gnyis su med par bsgom/ /dge dang sdig dang bde dang sdug bsngal dang | | de bzhin 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa sems lags te/ /sems de'ang kun nas yongs su brtag bgyis na/ kha dog ma mchis dbyibs kyang ma mchis la/ /gcig min du ma ma lags dai slad du/ / ngo bo ma mchis phyir na ma skyes shing*/ /mi gnas 'gags med mtha' dbus dang bral bas/ /spros med nam mkha'i ngang tshul nyid lags te/ /de lta na yang rig pa mi 'gag pas/ /rig stong zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid lags/ /bdag sems ji ltar lags pa de bzhin du/ /sems can kun yid (《 zha 》 gyi ) rang bzhin de nyid la/ /chos rnams kun kyang snang stong zung 'jug par/ /kun nas nges par bgyi zhing mi 'dzin pa'i/ /tshul gyis shin tu mnyam par bzhag par bgyi | | de ltar dmigs bcas gnyis dang dmigs med dang*/ /zung 'jug ngang (《 zha 》 tshul ) la mnyam par bzhag bgyis pas/ /rtog pa kun gyis rnam par mi bsgul ba'i/ /zhi gnas ting 'dzin dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /dge dang sdig pa bgyis pa thams cad kyi/ /rjes su dga' bas yang yang dran bgyid pa/ /de stobs slar yang 'phel bgyid de slad du/ /dge ba rjes dran bgyis pas 'phel bar mdzod/ khyad par dmigs pa gang la mnyam gzhag pa'i/ /rjes la dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang*/ /nyams su myong ba'i don gang la sogs pa/ / so sor brtags shing rnam par dpyad bgyis pas/ /de yi rgyu rkyen la sogs rten 'byung tshul/ /ji snyed pa dang de yang rnam dpyad pas/ /'ga' yang dmigs pa med pa ji lta'i don/ /ji bzhin rtogs pas lhag mthong bsgrub par bgyi/

/dge ba bgyis pa'i rjes su des mtshon pa'i/ /dge ba thams cad gcig tu bsdoms bgyis nas/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir yongs su bsngo/ /bsgyur bya'i dge ba dus der ma bsags kyang | | don chen smaun pas thob par gyur cig ces/ /smon lam btab pas don de 'grub 'gyur te/ /gang phyir sems nyid gtso bo lags phyir ro/ /de ltar rjes dran yongs su bsngo ba dang*/ /smon lam dam pas rjes su gang brgyan pa'i/ / dge ba thams cad mi zad 'phel ba dang*/ /bdag gzhan kun gyi don chen rgyur 'gyur lags/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa de dag dang*/ /gzhan yang 'dus byas chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /de kun rgyu dang rkyen la rag las pas/ /rang gi ngo bor ma grub bag chags kyis/ /rnam par bslad pa'i blo la sna tshogs su/ /snang zhing myong la der yang mi bden par/ /sna tshogs rkyen las byung ba'i sgyu ma dang | | gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam ji bzhin dgongs/ /'dus ma byas chos btags pa kho na ste/ /de la don med ming gi sgra dang ni/ /rnam par rtog pa de dag 'dus byas chos/ /don du 'dod pa gang de smyon pa lags/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rten 'byung mi bslu bas/ /ji ltar spyod pa'i rnam smin myong ba'i slad/ / las 'bras tshul la khyad du gsad mi bgyi/ /yod par bden 'dod rtag par blta ba'i tshul/ /phyogs dus med pa'i chos 'ga' ma mchis shing*/ /phyogs dang dus kyi rnam par dbye bgyis na/ /gcig pa'i dngos po gang na'ang srid ma lags | | gcig ma mchis par du ma gang las 'byung*/ /de dag las gzhan yod pa ma mchis pas/ /yod ces rnam par rtog pa gyi na lags/ /ring po med par thung ngu ji bzhin du/ /yod pa ngo bo nyid du ma grub pas/ /med pa gshis su lta yang ga la mchis/ /gnod pa gnyis kas rnam par bsal ba dang*/ /sgrub byed dang ni ltos pa ma mchis phyir/

/gnyis dang gnyis min chos nyid ma lags par | | shes rab gsal ba khyod kyis mkhyen par bgyi/ /sems la gzugs med phyir na phyogs med pas/ /gcig pu nyid du bden zhes rnam rtog na/ /rnam pa du mar snang ba'i gzung 'dzin dang*/ /gcig na sems de'ang du ma nyid dang ni | | brdzun par 'gyur zhing gal te tha dad na/ /chos dang chos nyid du yang ji ltar 'gyur/ /gnyis su snang ba yang ni gang las 'byung*/ /'khrul pa zad pas mya ngan 'das pa'ang ci/ /gzung ba ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pas/ /'dzin pa yang ni ngo bo nyid du med/ /de dag las gzhan gsal rig bden smra ba/ /rnam 'gyur las gzhan bdag gzhan shin tu brdzun/ /gdod nas ma skyes ngo bo nyid med cing*/ /shin tu spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su mkhyen bgyis nas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dmigs pa med par bgyi | | chos kun stong pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /'di ni rmad byung de ltar shes pa ni/ /ngo mtshar las kyang shin tu ngo mtshar lags/ /yul kun snang stong zung du 'jug pa dang*/ /blo yang rig stong zung du 'jug pa dang*/ /lam rnams thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug tu/ / mkhyen zhing kun nas yongs su goms par bgyi/ /rten 'byung kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ /rang bzhin don dam stong pa nyid dang yang*/ /gnyis ka'ang dbyer med zung du 'jug par ni/ /rgyu lam 'bras bu'i chos kun mkhyen par mdzod/ /de ltar gzhi dang sngon 'gro mnyam gzhag dang*/ /rjes su bya dang kun la rgyas gdab lnga | | re re'ang gsum du phye ba'i chos bco lngas/ /dge ba'i lam (《 zha 》 chos ) kun yongs su bsdus pa stai/ /dge ba spyad pa'i rnam grangs re re la'ang*/ /chos tshul de dag tshang bar gang brtson pa/ /de yis mtho ris bde ba kun spyad de/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i tshogs ni rab bsags shing*/ /ting 'dzin gsal bas 'phags pa'i lam sbyar nas/

/bsgom dang spyod pas ye shes rgyas byas te/ / lam gyi mtha' yis mthar thug bsgrub pa ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa gang*/ /rtog pa zhi bas dbyings dang ro gcig pa/ /rang bzhin sku ste chos dbyings ye shes dang*/ /spangs pa phun tshogs ji lta mkhyen pa'ang de/ / 'khor ba'i chos rnams lam gyis rab bsgyur bas/ /lus gnas gyur pa mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku/ /ngag gnas gyur pa yan lag drug cu'i gsung*/ /yid gnas gyur pa ji snyed mkhyen bcas pa'i/ /ye shes gsum dang skyon rnams gnas gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan pha mtha' yas pa lags/ /de nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lags te/ /las gnas gyur pa bya grub ye shes dang*/ /phrin las bgrang yas de nyid sprul pa'i sku/ /de dag rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa lags | | dbang 'byor phyir na rtag cing rgyun mi 'chad/ /mi dbang khyod kyang de 'drar mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar theg mchog zab mo'i don bsdus nas/ /chos kyi skyes 'di phul ba'i dge ba des/ /rgyal po khyod kyis gtso byas 'gro ba kun/ / sangs rgyas go 'phang dam pa thob par shog /chos kyi skyes su bgyis pa'i rab byed 'di/ /phul bas slar yang spobs pa'i yid 'phel nas/ /cung zad gsol ba 'di la skye rgu'i rje/ /re zhig g.yel ba med par dgongs su gsol/ /nyid kyang nyid kyi sku tshe ring ba dang*/ /gdung rgyud brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal brten dang*/ /rnam grol brnyes pa'i thabs la brtson pa'i dus/ /da lta lags kyis g.yel med brtson par rigs/ /bstan pa chos kyi dpal yang ma nub cing | | chos rgyal mi dbang khyod 'dra'ang bzhugs bzhin du/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gnas skabs 'di 'dra ba/ /'di la khyod kyi thugs ni ji ltar dgongs/ / bdag kyang na tshod rgan po ma lags kyang*/ /lus stobs dman zhing sgyid lug yid kyang zhum/ /de slad dben par chos don tshol 'tshal bas/ /de dang mthun par bka' drin mdzad du gsol/

/rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pas lcags mo lug gi lo/ bya sbo'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la shing kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /de'i bsdus don bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di la don gnyis te/ dam pa'i chos kyi gdams pa dngos dang*/ zhar las skabs su bab pa'i don gsol ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don dang*/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don/ mthar phyin pa 'jug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis// ston pa la mchod par brjod pa dngos dang*/ zlos pa'i skyon spang ba gnyis kyi bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /gzhung gi don la gnyis/ chos brjod pa dang*/ sgrubs par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ 'di gang la brten pa'i gsung rab kyi don nyams su blang byar bstan pa/ de ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ 'dis dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su bsdus pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos re re la'ang tshang dgos par bstan pas don bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la lnga | lam gyi gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba kun nas slong ba'i bsam pa/ lam gyi dngos gzhi mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor lam gyi yon tan 'phel ba'i thabs rjes su bya ba/ lam dang chos thams cad la rgyas gdab pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po la gsum/ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed | ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon yang dag par blang ba/ ji ltar bsrung tshul bzhis rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig go /dang po la gnyis | dpe (《 zha 》 des ) bstan pa sdom pa yang dag par blang ba/ de ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul dang*/ de ltar bsrungs pa'i phan yon gsum gyis don bstan pa'o

| | sems bskyed pa la gsum/ snying rje/ 'dun pa/ grub par nus pa gsum gyis skye ba'i rgyu/ yang dag par blang ba/ mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs so | | gnyis pa lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ skye ba'i rgyu yul dang bcas pa dang*/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis kyis dad pa/ dpe bstan pa dmigs pa rnams kyi don la sbyar ba gnyis kyis snying rje/ gang la 'dun pa'i yul dang*/ ji ltar 'dun pa'i tshul gnyis kyis 'dun pa bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi mnyam par bzhag pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum | dmigs bcas bsgom pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba sems su bstan pa dang*/ de ji ltar bstan pa dang*/ de ji ltar brtag pa dang*/ brtags pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa gsum gyis dmigs med bsgom pa dang*/ zung 'jug gi rang bzhin dang*/ chos thams cad de'i ngang tshul du bstan pa dang*/ ji ltar mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul gsum gyis zung 'jug bsgom pa'o/ / dmigs bcas la gnyis/ yul gyi gtso bo dang*/ gnas 'khor dang bcas pa dang | mchod pa'i tshul gsum gyis sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ yul gyi rang bzhin dang | nam bsgom pa'i dus/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas dang*/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul bzhis bla ma bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa rjes su bya ba la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rgyu mtshan spyir bstan pa dang | dge ba'i rjes su de dran byar gdams pa dang*/ skabs su babs pa mnyam gzhag gi rjes la sbyar ba dang*/ de'i phan yon lhag mthong 'byung ba bzhis dngos gzhi'i don rjes su dran par bya ba/ de'i dge ba yongs su bsngo ba/ ngo bo gang yin pa dang*/ de'i phan yon gnyis kyis smon lam gdab pa'o/ /lnga pa thams cad la rgyas gdab pa la gnyis/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o | | dang po la gsum/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu/

don dam pa rang bzhin med pa | zung 'jug gi rang bzhin dang*/ de shes pa ngo mtshar gyi gnas yin pa dang*/ j-i ltar shes par bya ba dang*/ de chub par bya bar gdams pa bzhis ngo bo zung du 'jug pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ khyad par bzhi dang*/ khyad par gyi chos bzhi dang*/ dpe bstan pa gsum gyis 'dus byas kyi chos/ btags pa bar bstan pa dang*/ de'i sgra rtog 'dus byas nyid yin pa dang*/ rdzas yod du rtog pa 'khrul bar bstan pa gsum gyis 'dus ma byas/ las 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa/ gol sa bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa don dam pa rang bzhin med pa la gsum/ 'khrul par brtag pa dgag pa dang*/ spros bral gyi rang bzhin la ji ltar mnyam par 'jog pa'o | | dang po la gnyis/ gcig dang du ma dgag pa gnyis kyis yod pa dgag pa med pa dgag pa/ gnyis ka dgag pa/ gnyis ka ma yin pa dgag pa bzhis phyi rol gyi don dgag pa/ rnam rig dgag pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ phyogs snga ma brjod pa/ gcig dang tha dad brtag pa/ yul ma grub pas yul can mi 'grub pa | de gnyis las gzhan du 'dod pa (《 zha 》+ gsum gyi ) dgag pa'o/ /gsum pa nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis/ mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ don dngos so | | de la gnyis/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'o/ /de la gnyis | gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gyis 'jig rten pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ mthong lam dang bsgom lam gyis 'phags pa'i lam gyi gnas skabs so/ / mthar thug gi 'bras bu la gnyis/ mthar phyin gyi lam gyis 'bras bu bsgrub par bstan pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sprul pa'i sku/ de nyid rgyun mi 'chad par bstan pa bzhis grub pa'i 'bras bu dngos so/ /don gnyis pa zhar las skabs su babs pa'i don gsol ba la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ gsan par gsol ba/ don dngos so/ /de la gsum/ sku tshe ring ba/ gdung brgyud kyi dpal brtan pa dang*/

rnam grol sgrub pa'i thabs la gsol ba gsum gyis nyid kyi don gsol ba/ bstan pa spy-i'i don gsol ba/ bye brag tu rang gi gsol ba'o/ /don chen sgrub byed theg pa mchog /bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa yi/ /bsdus don sbyar ba'i dge ba yis/ /'gro kun chos kyi rgyal por shog | rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i bsdus pa'i don gyi gsal byed 'di ni/ shing mo phag gi lo khra'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bzhi'i nyin par/ tre yi sa cha dga' ldan gnas sar zhes bya bar/ gzhung rtsom pa po de nyid kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// //༄༅/ /theg chen gsal ba ¡Ã yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab byed ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bsdus don dang bcas pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ theg pa chen po gsal ba zhes bya ba yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / a sogs ka sogs thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las byung rgyal ba gang zhig chos kyi phung po che ba'i sku/ /brnyes pa khyod kyis rnam 'phrul sna tshogs yi ge'i sbyor bas sna tshogs thabs tshul kun nas gsal byed sde tshan gyi/ /rnam par dbye ba'i ye shes dbye bas tha dad rigs mtshon 'gyur ba med phyir nges pa'i sku ste ma skyes pa'i/ /srog gi yi ger rang bzhin gcig gyur rgyal ba khyod zhabs gus pas btud de khyod gsung yi ger spel ba brjod/ /ka la piṅka'i nga ro'i sgra dbyangs sgo nga'i nang du bsgrags pa'i sgra yis rnam par sgrogs pa'i 'dab chags gzhan

| kha dog dag kyang zil gyis mnan nas rnam par rmugs byed dregs pa'i nga ro kun nas 'khyil bzhin sgrogs pa'i tshal/ /ga la ba der rnam par dul ba'i yid kyi 'dun pas kun nas 'dud pa'i spy-i bo'i gtsug gis 'dud byed bzhin | | nga ru 'dzin pa'i ∶sgo nga'i nang (《 zha 》 sgo lnga'i gang ) gnas rgyal ba'i sras su dam 'cha'i nga ros rang rgyal dgra bcom zil gnon byed/ /ca co'i sgra sgrogs rtog pa'i rba klong rnam par 'khrug cing las kyi 'phen pas gya gyur 'gyur ba'i yid kyi klung*/ /cha yi cha yang gzhal bar rab dka'i byang chub sems kyi chu gter chur zhugs chu klu?ng dregs bral mngar ba dang*/ /ja yi ro sogs tshul min yid byed sna tshogs ro rnams kun nas snying brtse'i lan tshwa'i ror gcig brtan gnas nas/ /nya mid dang ni de mid sogs ltar dpag yas 'byung po'i nyer 'tshor nyer gnas yon tan rin chen gter 'dzin 'gyur/ /tak+ṣa ka sogs klu mchog rnams kyi gtsug na rab mdzes mdzes pa'i dbyibs ldan 'od zer dra bas sa 'og gi /tha grus khyab pa'i mun nag tshang tshing rnam par 'joms byed rab tu 'byor ba'i dpal 'byor dam pas rang gi sde/ /da lta nyid du kun nas 'byor ¡Ã byed yid (《 zha ¡· - byed yid ) bzhin nor ltar blo mchog rnams kyi blo gros gtsug gnas byang chub sems/ /na sogs srid zhi'i rgud pa rab sel rab tu 'byor pa'i 'byor pa gnyis kyis bdag gzhan kun nas 'byor par byed/ /pa sangs mtshan mor 'jigs pa'i mtshan ma nye bar 'char bzhin bdag med shes rab srid pa 'jigs pa'i mtshan ma ste/ /pha rol phyin drug srid dang zhi ba'i pha rol bgrod byed rang gi don gyi yon tan kun 'byung 'dod 'jo yi/ /ba mchog dang ni grub pa'i bum bzang yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'byung bas ma lus 'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs byed bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi las grub pa'i 'bras/

/tsa ri'i ri sogs 'phags pa'i ri gzhan bye ba phrag brgyas dpe zlar 'os min rgyal ba lhun po ltar brjid pa/ /tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer ltar gsal bye ba khrag gi kha dog gis spel spel legs 'od zer sprau mdzad pas/ /dza ṭā'i cod pan zla tshes kyis mtshan 'phrog byed la sogs lha yi gtso bo che bar rab grags gang yin pa'ang*// wa ltar zhum zhing nyin mor byed pas 'byung po'i bya ltar rnam par rmugs byed gdul bya'i dpal du gyur ba gang*/ /zha nye'i khams las gzhan gyi rkyen gyis li khri'i 'gyur bar kun nas bsgyur ltar srid pa'i nyes brgya'ang 'grol ba'i chos// za 'og mdangs ltar rnam par bkra ba'i yon tan gyis bkra gnas yongs gyur pa rgyal ba'i chos rnams bgrang yas pa'ang*/ /wa zhwa'i rigs sogs sna tshogs rigs rnams mi yi rigs su kun nas gcig ltar zag med dbyings su ro gcig cing*/ /ya rabs rab kyi mdzad spyod ya mtshan mtshon pa'i dpe bral mkha' dbyings khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad pas sred pa yi/ /ra bas dam bcings srid pa'i rgya mtshor sdug bsngal rgya mtshos rnam par gdungs pa'i 'gro ba'i 'ching ba rnams dral nas/ /la la byang chub dam par lung ston gzhan dag nyer zhi'i dbyings su nyer 'jog la la phun sum tshogs mdzad gang*/ /sha yi spyan sogs spyan lngas nyer gzigs rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rnam par 'phrul mdzad bye ba khrag khrig chos kyi sgo/ /sa dang bar snang nam mkha' las kyang rnam par sgrogs par kun tu sprul mdzad mdzad pa'i phrin las 'di 'dra yis/ /ha cang rgud pa'i ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba'ang kun tu 'dren na bde 'gro'i 'gro ba bde la 'god pa smos ci dgos | | a yi yi ge yi ge'i tshogs kyi srog tu gnas bzhin rgyu lam 'bras bu'i chos kyi chos nyid stong nyid yin/ /de ltar rgyu dang theg chen lam bzang mngon par grub pa 'bras bu'i ∶mchog dang thams cad (《 zha 》 tshogs dang

) dbyer med rnam pa bzhis/ /theg mchog chos rnams yongs su bsdu phyir theg chen don la blo gros rab gsal theg pa mchog gi ngang tshul can/ /'phags pa min yang 'phags pa'i ming ldan 'phags mchog gang zhig dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba rnam 'dren gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi bos len pas yi ge'i ma mo nyid la spel nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs 'di bsgrags/ /lhag bsam dṛ med klu dbang gis sprul rnam dpyod chu 'dzin spobs pa'i glog 'od kun nas rab tu 'gyur ba las | | sdeb sbyor tshig gi sbyor ba sna tshogs bsdebs legs ngag gis rnam par bsdebs pa'i dri med tshig gi char rgyun gang*/ /nye bar phab pas skye rgu'i yid gzhir dad pa'i chu klung rnam par spel bas sems kyi tha ba brlan byas nas/ / 'byor pa'i myu gu rnam par grol ba'i me tog gis bkra byang chub dam pa'i 'bras bus brgyan pa smin gyur cig /theg pa chen po gsal ba zhes bya ba yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ lcags pho spre'u'i lo dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gcig la/ rgya nag po cong to'i mkhar du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /de'i bsdus don bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ theg pa chen po gsal ba la don gsum | rtsom pa dang 'brel pa klad kyi don/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don/ mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa'i sgo nas lus mdor bstan pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /gzhung gi don la bzhi/ shugs kyis bstan pa theg pa chen po'i rgyu/ dngos su bstan pa theg pa chen po'i lam/ mngon par grub pa theg pa chen po'i 'bras bu/ thams cad dbyer mi phyed pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no/ /gnyis pa lam la gnyis/ lam gyi gzhi byang chub kyi sems dang*/ lam mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs so | | dang po la gsum/

so so skye bo'i gnas skabs su (《 zha 》 - su ) mos pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ sa bdun gyi gnas skabs lhag bsam dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ dag pa (《 zha 》+ sa ) gsum gyi gnas skabs rnam par smin pa'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /gnyis pa mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs la gnyis | lta ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ rang gi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dang*/ gzhan yongs su smin par byed pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i spyod pa'o/ /don gsum pa mngon par grub pa'i 'bras bu la bzhi/ 'bras bu'i ngo bo mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa/ grub pa'i tshul gnas yongs su gyur pa/ rten zag pa med pa'i dbyings dang gnyis su med pa/ mdzad pa lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ zhi ba las khyad par du 'phags pa dang*/ srid pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'o/ /gnas gyur pa la gsum/ gang gnas gyur pa'i dpe dang bcas pa/ ji ltar gnas gyur pa'i dpe dang bcas pa/ gang du gnas gyur pa'i dpe'o/ /gnyis su med pa la gnyis/ gang zhig gnyis su med pa dpe dang bcas pa/ gang du gnyis su med pa dpe dang bcas pa'o/ / mdzad pa phrin las la ∶mnga' mdzad pa la bzhi(《 zha 》 lnga ) / mdzad pa rgya che zhing rgyun mi 'chad pa/ mdzad pa'i las bde ba dang grol ba la dgod pa/ mdzad pa'i tshul cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum/ mdzad pa de dag gi don yongs su bsdu ba'o | | spy-i don gsum pa 'jug gi don la gnyis/ gang zhig gang gis ji ltar byas pa dang*/ de ltar byas pa'i dge ba yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /theg chen gsal ba'i bsdus don gyi/ /gsal byed 'di ni rje dbus pa/ /rin chen rdo rje rab bskul nas/ /gzhung rtsom nyid kyis byas pa yin/ /theg pa chen po gsal ba'i bsdus don gyi gsal byed shing pho byi ba'i lo sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par/ rong po'i yul snyi'i lung par bris pa'o//

//༄༅/ /las 'bras gsal ba'i me long bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis las 'bras rten 'byung kun/ /nyid kyis ji bzhin gzigs gyur nas/ /brtse bas 'gro la ji bzhin du/ /ston mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi las dang 'bras bu yi/ / rnam gzhag ji bzhin mi shes na/ /blang dor don la rmongs 'gyur bas/ /de gsal bya phyir 'dir bshad bya/ /yid kyis kun nas bslang ba yi/ /sgo gsum gyi ni byed pa gang*/ /las yin zhes ni thub pas gsungs/ /de la 'bras bu'i dbye ba gsum/ /kun nas yid du 'ong ba yi/ /'bras bu bskyed pa dge ba ste/ / bzlog pa'i 'bras 'byin sdig pa yin/ /yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong bas/ /stong pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms te/ /des bskyed las ni lung ma bstan/ /sraug gcod rku dang 'dod log dang*/ /brdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang*/ /ngag 'khyal brnab sems gnod par sems/ /log lta dang ni mi dge bcu/ /mthong ba'i chos dang rnam smin la/ /myong ba'i 'bras bu rnam gnyis te/ /tshe thung nad mang zug rngu'i yid | | longs spyod chud 'dzad rgud pa dang*/ /gzhan yid mi phebs dgra dang bcas | | ngag mi btsan dang gzhan gyis bslu/ /bshes med pa dang mi snyan brjod | | rtag par yid ni g.yeng bcas dang*/ /re ba 'bras med sdang ba mang | | rtag par bde ba mi rnyed pa/ /tshe 'dir chung ngur myong ba ste/ /phyi mar chen por myong ba'o/ /zhe sdang las byung sdig pa yis/ /dmyal bar 'phen cing 'dod chags las/ /byung ba'i sdig pas yi dwags su/ /rmongs pas dud 'gror 'phen par byed/ /mang po'i don du gcig gsod sogs/ /kun slong nyon mongs min phyir dang*/ /phan pa'i 'bras bu che ba'i phyir/ /sdig pa'i gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /'bras bu yid 'ong bskyed pa yin/ /mi dge bcu po rnam bzlog pa/ /'di dag dkar po'i las lam bcu/

/mthong ba'i chos dang rnam smin la/ /myong ba'i 'bras bu rnam gnyis te/ /tshe ring nad med yid bde dang*/ / longs spyod 'phel zhing 'byor pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi yid phebs dgra dang bral/ / ngag btsan gzhan gyis bdag don bsgrub/ /bshes bzang pa dang gzhan gyis bstod | | rtag par yid ni rnal du phebs/ /re ba 'bras bcas byams pa mang*// rtag par rig pa'i lam rnyed pa/ /'di la chung ngur myong ba ste/ /phyi mar chen por myong ba'o/ /gti mug shas che'i dge bas mi/ /zhe sdang shas che lha min te/ / chags pas lha yi gnas su 'gro/ /nyon mongs zad pas mya ngan 'da'/ /thabs bcas byang chub chen po'i rgyu/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /ma bslad yid gang dad pa dang*/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis/ /kun nas bslang ba'i sbyin pa dang*/ /tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan dang ni shes rab rnams/ /sgo gsum po yis legs bsgrubs pa/ /kun nas dge ba'i spyod pa ste/ /'byor dang mtho ris bde ba dang*/ /gzugs bzang don kun lhun grub dang*/ /yid zhi ba dang ma rmongs pa/ /'jig rten 'dir smin 'bras bu ste/ /dpal dang grags dang mtshan dpe dang*/ /rmad du byung ba'i phrin las dang*/ /ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu'aphrul dang*/ /mi 'jigs yang dag rig pa yis/ /dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /mthar thug pa yi 'bras bu'o | | gsod sar sems can sbyin pa sogs/ /kun slong lhag bsam min phyir dang | | srog la nye bar 'tshe ba'i phyir/ /dge ba'i gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / 'bras bu sdug bsngal skyed byed yin/ /rtag par sdig pa'i las bsag kyang*/ / 'chi tshe dge bas mtshams sbyor na/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa'i phyir/ / bde 'gror skyes kyang rdzogs byed las/ /sdig pas nad can dbul po sogs/ / rtag par sdug bsngal gyis gzir 'gyur/ /rtag tu dge ba'-i las bsags kyang | | 'chi tshe sdig pas mtshams sbyar na/

/'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa'i phyir | | ngan 'gror skyes kyang rdzogs byed las/ /dge bas klu yi dbang po dang*// gnod sbyin mchog sogs bde ldan 'gyur/ /gnyis ka sdig pas rtag tu sdug / gnyis ka dge bas rtag par bde/ /dge sdig ma 'dres spyad pa'i 'bras/ /ma 'dres myong zhing 'dres ma yis/ /'dren mar myong 'gyur 'phen pa'i mthu/ / mchog dang dman pa'i bye brag gis/ /skyes dang lan grangs gzhan du myong*/ /rgyu yi nus pa stobs che'i las/ /'bras bu nges pa myong 'gyur te/ /rkyen gyi nus pas ma nges 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'bras dang nas kyi ni/ /sa bon so sor btab pa las | | myu gu'ang 'chol ba med par ni/ /so sor smin pa ji bzhin du/ /dge dang sdig pa'i las kyis kyang*/ /bde sdug 'bras bu so sor 'byin/ /yul dang dngos dang bsam pa'i stobs/ /shin tu mthu dang ldan pa'i 'bras/ /rgyal bas bzlog par mi spyaud na/ /gzhan gyis smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /'on kyang byang chub sems sogs dang*/ /yang dag stong nyid ye shes kyis/ /las kyi sgrib pa kun sel ba/ /rtsa ba'i gnyen po yin phyir rmad/ /de lta'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la | | yid ches gyur pas sdig pa'i las/ /spong dang dge ba bsgrub pa la/ / 'jug par 'gyur ba yin te dper/ /mig ldan g.yang sa'i lam dor nas/ / bde ba'i lam la 'jug pa bzhin/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /chen po su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni tshe rabs stong du yang*/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba ma yin no | | sdig la 'dzem zhing bshags pa dang*/ /dge la spro zhing yongs bsngos pas | | snga ma'i rgyu las 'bras bu'i chos/ /shin tu 'phel bar 'gyur bas na/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ni/ /tshegs med par yang 'grub par 'gyur/ / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du/ /shes pas de yi chos nyid kyang*/ /spros bral nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /de lta'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yi/

/rten cing 'brel 'byung legs shes pa/ /lta spyod rnam par dag pa'i gzhi/ /yin phyir dang por bslab par bya/ /gzhon kyang rgan pa'i gzhi la gnas/ /'byor yang yon tan ched cher 'dzin/ /chen por gyur kyang khengs bral ba/ /jim gyim zhes byas legs bskul nas/ /gsung rab rab tu rnam 'byed pa'i/ /shes rab rab gsal bstan bcos kun/ /mkhyen rab rab mchog gsung pa bzhin/ /rab tu smra ba'i 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ /kun tu mi dge'i spyod pa kun/ /kun nas spangs te rgyal ba kun/ /kun tu mnyes pa'i lam brten shog | rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin chen las/ /rnam dpyod mgar bas legs bsgrugs pa'i/ /las 'bras gsal ba'i me long 'di/ /blo gsal rnams kyis blta bar gyis/ /las dang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa gsal bar ston pa/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ lung dang ṛgs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par smra ba/ 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ sa pho rta'i lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu dgu la sbyar ba rdzogs so// //tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu tham pa bzhugs so// //༄༅/ /rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsod nams rgya mtshor rab tu 'khrungs/ /ye shes tshogs kyis che ba'i sku/ / dpag yas yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /rgyal ba lhun po la phyag 'tshal/ /dge ba rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khrungs/ /rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i gzi brjid ldan/ / rang srid rnam par skyong ba'i dpal/ /rgyal bu rin chen rgyal gyur cig /tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhi ston zhing*/ /mang du thos pa'i chu gter can/ /yon tan rin chen tshogs 'dzin pa/ /'phags pa'i blo yi rgya mtsho las/ /byung ba'i spring yig nor bu'i phreng*/ /phyogs kun gsal ba'i 'od 'byin zhing*/ /bdag gzhan mdzes pa bskyed pa'i rgyan/ /bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'bul/ khyod kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs phyir/ /nor gyi skyes kyis ci zhig bgyi/ /dgung zla'i 'od kyis kun+da ltar/ /gsal bar bgyi slad chos skyes 'bul/ /gang la 'di dpal phun tshogs kyang*/ /chos dpal rnam par mi ldan na/ /dug bcas kha zas bzang za bzhin/ /sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed pa lags/ /gang zhig chos kyi dpal ldan yang*/ /'jig rten dpal gyis dben gyur na/ /shun pa bcas pa'i rin chen ltar/ /gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ma lags/ /gang la de gnyis phun tshogs na/ /gnyis ka'i don chen 'grub 'gyur te/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i rin po ches/ /rang gzhan mdzes par bgyid pa ltar/ /de slad nyid la tshul gnyis kyi | | dpal dang ldan pa gang lags pa/ /kun nas 'bras bu mchis bgyi'i slad | | 'di brjod pa la rtse gcig dgongs/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang rgya mtsho'i klong | | lhun po'i brtan pa gang lags pa'ang*/ /dus mthar nyams par 'gyur lags na/ /'gro ba'i 'byor pa smos ci 'tshal/ /'di 'dra mkhyen pas khyod dpal gyis/ khyod thugs dregs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /dpal gyis dpal yang 'phel bgyi'i slad/

/rtag tu bag yod bsten 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal ba yis thugs 'byung dang*/ /bde ba'ang 'gyur ba'i chos can dang*/ /kun kyang kun 'byung las byung dang*/ /de yis de rgyu mdzad bgyid par/ khyod kyis rtag tu dgongs bgyis nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi gdung bas thugs/ /kun nas nyon mongs mi 'gyur zhing*/ /dge ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /tshogs dang smon lam mthun pa'i mthus/ /dngos dang brgyud pas nyid kyis sku/ /bskyed bgyis yab yum brgyud bcas kyi/ /bka' drin dgongs par mdzod cig dang*/ /tshul lugs dge ba spyad pa'i phyir/ /gdung brgyud chu bo lta bu dang*/ /de dag nyid la 'dun pa dang*/ /dgongs pa'ang ji bzhin bsgrub 'gyur lags/ /gang gi dpal la mngon brten nas/ /de yi bka' drin nos gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /rtag tu bkur bar mdzod cig dang*/ /de ni nyid la rin chen ltar/ / bzhed rgu ma lus stsol 'gyur zhing*/ /nyid kyang 'gro ba gzhan dag gis/ / bkur 'os nyid du 'gyur ba lags/ /rigs kyi nang nas rgan pa dang*/ /smra ba'i nang nas bden smra dang*/ /gzhung lugs nang nas 'thad ldan dang*/ /brtul zhugs ldan las gzhan phan can/ /nor gyi nang nas rig pa dang*/ /ya rabs nang nas yon tan ldan/ /dman pa'i nang nas nyam thag dang*/ /nyam thag nang nas nad pa dang*/ /chung ma'i nang nas rjes 'brang dang*/ /bu yi nang nas rig 'dzin dang*/ /gnyen gyi nang nas mi slu dang*/ /grogs kyi nang nas phan 'dogs dang | | bran gyi nang nas bsgo ba nyan/ /phan btags nang nas drin gzo dang*/ / gnod bgyid nang nas bzod gnas dang*/ /kun gyi nang nas glo bur lhags/ / de dag rnams la der dgongs nas/ /bkur dang bskyang bar mdzod cig dang*/ / skye bo gzhan yang des rkyen gyis/ /tshul ldan las la 'jug 'gyur lags/ /nya pa dang ni shan pa sogs/ /gzhan la 'tshe ba de dag gis/ /bdag gi don yang mi 'grub na/ /gzhan don smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal/

/slob ma rgyal sras rgyal ba rnams | | gzhan gyi don gyi khyad par gyis/ /tha ma 'bring dang mchog gi tshul/ / brnyes pa lkog gyur lags mod kyang*/ /nyung ngu 'bring dang mang po la/ /nye bar phan pa don gnyer bas/ /chung ngu 'bring dang chen po yi/ /gtso bor 'gyur pa ma gzigs sam/ /de slad lus can ji snyed la/ khyed thugs brtse bar rigs lags na/ /nyid la brten pa'i skye bo la/ /brtse bar rigs pa smos ci 'tshal/ / nyid la rten dang srog ldan par/ /nyid kyis 'gro rnams mtshungs bzhin du/ /la la bkums nas gzhan 'ga' zhig /tshim bgyid chos kyi tshul ma lags/ / gnod pa med par mang po'i yid/ /dga' bgyid rtse 'jo'i sbyor lags pas/ / skyo ba bsal phyir dus bab tshe/ khyod kyis rol par rigs lags kyang*/ /skye bo log par goms pa'i yid/ /gnas skabs dga' phyir mang po la/ /'tshe bgyid brtags na mya ngan gyur/ khyed kyis mkhyen par mdzad nas spongs/ /rang gis nongs par spyad bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi tshig rtsub mi bzod par/ /nongs med sems can 'gums bgyid pa/ /'di las 'gal ba gzhan ci mchis/ /gzhan la brtse bas bdag 'dun dang*/ /gzhan bskyangs pa yis bdag mchod dang*/ / snyan par smra bas bdag bstod pa/ /tshul 'di dngos po'i chos lags pas/ / byang chub don du brtse ba dang*/ /phan par bsgrub pa lta zhog gi /'jig rten don du gnyer bas kyang*/ /de 'drar rigs pa ma lags sam/ /de ltar dgongs nas gzhan dag la/ /phan dang brtse bar mdzod cig dang*/ /'di dang phyi ma'i bdag gzhan don/ /ma lus 'grub par 'gyur lags grang*/ /tshe dang dpal dang chos 'phel na/ /'o brgyal dang du blang bgyi ste/ /bzlog na bzlog pa'ang bzlog pa ru | khyod kyis nan tan mdzad 'tshal lo/ /nor gyis 'khor bsrung 'khor gyi lus | | de yi srog dang thams cad kyis/ /dam chos bsrung zhes dam pa rnams/ / gsung gis kun nas dgongs par mdzod/ /chos dang 'jig rten don 'ga' zhig

| gnas skabs la lar ma grub kyang*/ /nyid thugs ldog par mi bgyi ste/ / tshong dang zhing pa'i tshul la gzigs/ /bsgrub bya'i don chen cig car du/ / 'grub pa shin tu dka' lags kyang*/ /rim gyis bsgrubs na 'grub dka' ba'ang | | 'grub par 'gyur te grog mkhar bzhin/ /bya ba rgya chen bsgrub pa la | | 'gal bgyid gcig kyang mang ba ste/ /dug dang ldan pa'i mda' gcig gis | | 'gro ba srog dang bral bar bgyid/ /phan bgyid rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyang | | mangs par gyur pa ma lags te/ /rgyal srid ji tsam yangs gyur pa'i/ / rgyal po'ang chen po ma lags sam/ /thabs dang ldan na gnod bgyid pa'ang*/ / bdag gi dpung du 'gyur ba ste/ /glang chen khros pa lcags kyu yis/ /btul nas 'khor bar blo ldan bgyid/ /drag shul sbyor bas dgra bo rnams/ /gdul zhes 'jig rten smra lags kyang*/ /zhi bas zhi bar 'gyur lags te/ /me la me dang chu bzhin no/ /rtsub mos gnod byed gcig bcom yang*/ /slar zhing mang bar 'gyur lags te/ /gram pa'i khrod kyi zug rngu'i rdo/ /bsal na ji ltar 'gyur ba dgongs/ /thabs kyis de dag dbang bgyis na/ /mang bzhin bdag phyogs brtan 'gyur te/ /brag ri brtsegs par gnas bcas pa'i/ /gnas khang brling ba ma lags sam/ /de ltar phyogs gzhan dbang bgyis nas/ /nyid kyi chab 'og mchis pa rnams/ /kun nas chos bzhin bskyang bgyi ste/ /chos kyis 'jig rten bde bgyi slad/ /byams dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /go 'phang 'tsham par stsol ba dang*/ /zang zing lhug par stsal ba yis/ /srid 'bangs bskyangs bar mdzod cig dang*/ /ji ltar bskyangs pa las byung ba'i/ /dpal 'byor bskrun pa gang lags pa/ /de kun nyid kyi dpal 'gyur zhing*/ /'du ba'i sgo mor 'du lags te/ /ji lta ji ltar zhing pa yis/ /zhing la so nam 'bad bgyis pa/ /de lta de ltar ston thog kyang*/ /de yis thob pa ma lags sam/ / srid 'bangs nyid du mtshungs lags kyang*/

/log dang legs par bgyis pa la | | tshar gcad rjes 'dzin bgyi 'tshal te/ /lus kyi nad dang zungs bzhin no | | tshar gcad pa la spyau ba dang*/ /brdeg dang phrog dang ngan smad pas/ /sun 'byin bgyid par rigs lags kyi/ /srog dang bral bgyid de ltar min/ /dri ma dag dang bcas pa'i gos/ /bkrus nas spyod bgyid mkhas pa ste/ /bsregs nas med par bgyis pa la/ /mdzangs pa lags zhes su zhig gleng*/ /go 'phang 'tsham par stsal bgyi ste/ /bzlog na bzlog par 'gyur du mchi/ /chung ngu khye'u nar son la/ kha zas sbyor ba'i tshul la dgongs/ /yon tan med dang skyon med pa | | 'jig rten 'di na mchis ma lags/ /shas che ba dang gnas skabs la/ / brtags nas blang dang dor bgyi ste/ /du bar bcas pa'i sgron me dang*/ /myangs na zhim pa'i dug dang ni/ /thang dang chu la bgrod pa la/ /shing rta dang ni gru bzhin no/ /longs spyod tshul bzhin mkhyen bgyi ste/ /dgra dang gnyen du gyur pa dang | | de bzhin don med gyur pa dang*/ /bzhi pa longs spyod nyid gyur lags// tshol dang bsags pas dang po dang*/ /bskyed dang bsrung bas bar dang ni/ /ngang gis gnod dang 'thab rtsod kyis/ /tha mar gnod 'gyur longs spyod dgra/ / legs par rnyed dang lhun grub pa'i/ /dngos po dag pa dge ba'i blos/ /mchod dang sbyin par bgyis pa yi/ /longs spyod phan pa bskyed phyir gnyen/ /phan gnod med par thob pa gang*/ /sbyin dang spyod par mi byed par/ /rtag tu 'jog dang chud zos pa'i/ /longs spyod de na don med lags/ /thog mar ji ltar rnyed kyang rung*/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis spyad bgyis pas/ /gnas skabs bde bar bgyid pa gang*/ /de ni longs spyod gyur pa lags/ /de dag rnams las dang po dang | | gsum pa rtag tu spang bgyi ste/ /gnyis pa kun tu spyod bgyi zhing*/ /bzhi pa ci rigs dag tu mdzod/ /chog shes med par longs spyod pa/ /sdug bsngal skyed par bgyid pa ste/

/lus zungs nyams dang ma zhu'i nad/ /gang las byung ba dgongs par mdzod/ /chang gis 'jig rten brnyas bgyid cing*/ /lus rgud blo gros nyams par bgyi/ /don nyams chos dang bral bgyid pas/ /chang la rtag tu dug bzhin gzigs/ /gzhan yang 'dod la chags pa yis/ /bsags pa'i dge ba 'dzad pa dang*/ /rtag tu bya ba nyams 'gyur bas/ /chog shes rtag tu bsten 'tshal lo/ /bya ba sgrub pa'i tshul yang ni/ /brtags nas bsgrub pa mdzangs pa ste/ /bsgrubs nas rtog pa blun po zhes/ /dam pa'i gzhung las 'byung lags pas/ /nyid kyi bgyi ba gang lags pa/ /brtags shing bgros nas mdzod cig dang*/ /don kun 'grub 'gyur gzhan du na'ang*/ /'gyod pa med par 'gyur ba lags/ /mdor na 'byor dang rgud pa yis/ /dregs dang zhum mi 'gyur ba dang*/ /byas shes drin du gzo ba dang*/ /mchod 'os mchod dang dman pa skyong*/ /phyogs gzhan dbang du bgyi ba dang*/ /yul 'khor chos bzhin skyong ba dang | | longs spyod bag yod spyod pa dang*/ /bya ba mdzangs par bsgrub pa lags | | de ltar bgyis pas 'jig rten 'dir/ /phun sum tshogs par gyur pa des | | pha rol bde ba gnyer bgyi'i slad/ /bde ba'i lam la 'jug 'tshal lo | | sna tshogs lam du khrid bgyid pa'i/ /ston pa rab tu mang mchis mod/ /rgyu dang bcas pa'i nyes bcom zhing/ /yon tan yongs rdzogs mchog lags kyang*// bdag ni yon tan dman pa dang*/ /de bzhin skyon dang ldan no zhes/ /su yang smra ba mi bgyid pas/ /rang bzhin sems pa'i dpyod pa yis/ /de yi spyod dang des bstan pa'i/ /gzhung las de tshul 'tshal bgyi ste/ /gzhung gang ngag tshig dri ma med | | tshad ma gnyis kyis nges par grub/ /'gal dang ma 'brel rnam par spangs | | gcig tu phan dang bder bgyid pa'i/ /gzhung lugs de ni dam pa ste | | de 'dra gzhan la ltos med par/ /rang gi mthu yis 'byed bgyid pa'i/ / ston pa ston pa'i mchog lags pas/ /de yi gsung gi rjes 'jug pa'i/

/skye bo rnams kyang dam pa lags/ /de slad chos la yid ches nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rab dad pas/ /sras dang slob ma'i rjes 'jug pa/ /dpyod ldan dam pa lags pa'i phyir/ /nyid kyang sangs rgyas chos tshogs kyis/ /yon tan mkhyen nas dad pa dang*/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob don du/ /ston pa lam dang grogs kyi phyir/ /ji srid 'tsho zhing gzhes kyi bar/ /skyabs kyi dam par gzung du gsol/ /de ni nyes kun sel ba dang*/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi chen lags/ / de ltar skyabs mchog nyer bstan zhing*/ /bdud rtsi'i sgo mor zhugs pa des/ / rtag tu chos bzhin bgyi 'tshal te/ /de yi gzhi yang tshul khrims lags/ / bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa yis/ /nyin zhag dge bar mdzod cig dang*/ / tshul khrims dag la goms 'gyur zhing*/ /'dod lhar mchi zhes rgyal bas gsungs | | yang srid dag la mtshams sbyor ba'i/ /sred dang 'du 'dzi spang phyir dang | | kun spyod rnam par dag bgyi'i phyir/ /so sor thar pas bsdam par bgyi | | yongs su rdzogs par mi spyod kyang*/ /ci rigs ci nas brten 'tshal te | | tha na sna gcig spyod pas kyang*/ /nyid kyi brtul zhugs mdzes par mdzod// goms na dka' ba ma mchis par/ /dge ba ngang gis 'phel 'gyur lags/ /de yis shes bya thams cad la/ /mkhas shing rnam par grol bgyi'i phyir/ /rigs dang gzhung lugs sna tshogs pa/ /mang las mang du gsan pa dang*/ /gzigs dang gleng bar bgyi ba la/ /nyid thugs gzhol bar mdzod cig dang*/ /gtsug lag kun la mkhas pa dang*/ /bye brag rnam par phyed pa yis/ /blang dang dor bya'i 'jug ldog la/ /kun tu 'khrul par 'gyur ma lags/ khyad par dam chos tshul chen la/ /ngoms pa med par gsan bgyi ste/ /shes bya'i snying po lags phyir dang*/ /mkhyen rab dge ba 'phel 'gyur phyir/ /som nyi blo yis skyes bu'i don | | 'grub par dka' ba gnas pa ltar/ /gsan yang de don ma nges na/ / don du 'gyur ba'ang rab dka' bas/

khyod kyis gsan pa gang lags pa/ /yang dag rigs pas rnam dpyad na/ /don bzhin nges par 'gyur lags te/ /snang bcas gzugs la mig gis bzhin/ /de ltar gsan dang dpyod pa la/ /gzhol na nyung ngu nyung ngus kyang*/ /rim gyis mkhyen pa 'phel 'gyur te/ /bung bas sbrang rtsi ji bzhin no/ /'di ni lung gi chos la dbang*/ /bsgyur bar bgyid pa'i thabs chen te/ /so nam las kyi ston thog ltar/ /rtogs chos zas kyi rgyu chen lags | | de yis srid pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /de rgyu las dang nyon mongs par// nges nas dge ba spel ba dang*/ /mi sdug pa dang byams pa dang*/ /rten 'byung khams kyi dbye ba dang*/ /dbugs dbyung rngub pa rjes dran dang*/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos rnams la/ /so sor rtog cing mnyam 'jog pas/ /mtho ris bde la gnas bcas te/ /tshogs dang sbyor bas 'jig rten dang*/ /mthong dang sgom dang mthar phyin pas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam bgrod de/ /thabs dang sbyangs pa'i bye brag gis/ /ston dang slob ma'i rigs dang ni/ /yon tan dag gis rab phye ba'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni theg pa chung ngu yi

| | chos tshul mdo tsam smos pa ste/ /theg pa che la 'dzeg pa yi/ /skas dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba lags/ /theg pa chung ngu'i lugs bstan pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //de ltar 'di dang pha rol gyi/ /bdag gi don la 'bad bgyis kyang*/ / gzhan gyi don gyi thabs chen las/ /nyams phyir sangs rgyas rgyang ring lags/ / gang zhig gzhan gyi don brtson na/ /gnyis ka'i don chen 'grub 'gyur gyi/ / gzhan don nyams pa'i rang don gyis/ /bdag don phun tshogs ga la srid/ / mang du smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ /rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ /gla rngan tsam gyis bdag skyong ba/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par gzigs/ /de slad gzhan don dga' ba yi/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /lus can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu | | thams cad mkhyen pa brnyes bgyi'i slad/ /don gnyis brnyes pa'i rgyal ba dang | | de bsgrub bgyid pa'i theg chen dang*/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la// ston pa'i phyir dang mnyes bgyi'i phyir/ /bgrod bgyi'i phyir dang brtan bgyi'i phyir | | grogs phyir 'khor du bsdu bgyi'i phyir/ /dgongs pa de dag brnyes kyi bar | | lus can kun dang thabs cig pa'i/ /skyabs kyi dam par gzung du gsol | | de ni bzhed rgu 'byung ba yi/ /byang chub sems kyi rin po che/ /nye bar bsgrub pa'i gzhir 'gyur zhing*/ /srid zhi'i dge gzhan zil gnon bgyid/ / sems la sems las ma gtogs pa'i/ /rgyu gzhan ma mchis skad cig gi / bdag nyid phyir na rgyu med pa'ang/ /ma lags sems nyid sems kyi rgyu/ /de phyir sems la thog ma'i mtha'/ /rnam pa kun tu mchis ma lags/ /de ldan phyir na sems can lags/ /mkha' la pha mtha' ma mchis pa/ /'jig rten khams kyang de dang mtshungs/ /de la brten pa'i sems can yang*/ /gzhal du med par mkhyen par mdzod/ /'di ni byams brtse'i yul lags te/ /de dag so so'i las kyi mthus/ /mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal gyi/

/phung pos kun nas gdung 'gyur zhing*/ /lam gsum brgyud mar 'khor 'gyur bas/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo mgal me yi/ /'khor lo ji bzhin 'khor 'gyur ba/ /'di ni srid pa'i tshig bla dwags/ /de lta mod kyi de yi khams/ /chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin phyir | | thabs dang ldan na de dag kun/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur lags kyang | | goms dang bag chags dman phyir dang*/ /rkyen dman phyir dang grogs dman phyir/ /gzhan gyi don las nyams 'gyur zhing*/ /rang gi don yang ma rdzogs pa'i/ /grol ba tsam du mchi bgyid pa/ /'di ni zhi ba'i tshig bla dwags/ / dgon par sprul pa'i grong khyer ltar/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu yin no zhes/ / thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs lags pas/ /rim gyis de dag rgyal bar mchi/ / srid zhi de dag 'jig rten dang*/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i bde ba ni/ /dri med rgyu dang bcas pa la/ /rtag tu gnas 'dod byams pa lags/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang*/ /theg pa dman dang de yi 'bras/ /gang la mchis de rgyur bcas pa/ /bral 'dod snying rje'i rnam pa lags/ /de slad tshul 'dis byams pa dang*/ /rtag tu thugs rjer mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar byams brtse'i yid mchis kyang*/ /de yi thabs la mi 'jug dang*/ /'jug kyang mthu dang mi ldan na/ /gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ma lags/ /de slad nyes kun sel ba dang*/ / yon tan kun la nyer sbyor ba'i/ /mthu stobs dam pa rab brnyes shing*/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i mthar son pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid lags la/ /de yang sems can las byung bas/ /bdag kyang de 'drar bya'o zhes/ /smon pa smon pa'i sems lags te/ /de yis dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ /brten nas yan lag phun tshogs pa'i/ /cho gas de ltar dam bca' ba/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed lags/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub byed pa'i/ /thabs tshul mtha' dag spyad do zhes/ /'dun pa 'jug pa'i sems lags te/ /dam 'cha' 'jug pa'i sems bskyed lags/

/'di ni ma bskyed bskyed pa'i thabs/ /skyes pa gong du 'phel bgyi'i phyir/ /spro ba chen pos smon pa dang*/ /rtsom pas 'jug pa mthar phyin mdzod/ /smon pa de yang 'gror 'dod dang*/ /'jug pa 'gro ba lta bu'i zhes | | rgyal sras 'ga' yis dper mdzad pa/ /smon 'jug bsgrub pa'i tshul la dgongs | | de ltar sems dang sems bskyed dang*/ /bsgrub pas smon 'jug rab dbye ba'i/ /tshul 'di 'ga' zhig kho nas bshad/ /'di ni kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /dpyad na dngos 'di du ma dang*/ /rjes 'brel phyir na gcig ma lags | | gcig med pa la du ma gang*/ /de gnyis las gzhan yod pa ci/ / yod pa med phyir med pa'ang gsog /'gal phyir gnyis ka'ang gshis ma lags | | sgrub byed med phyir gnyis min min/ /de phyir brtags na gnas med pas | | blos kyang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa/ /'di ni don dam byang sems kyi/ / rgyu mthun nyid lags rnam kun gyi/ /mchog ldan lta ba'ang de nyid lags/ / 'dzin pa med par mnyam 'jog dang*/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad kyis | | nges par bgyis pas don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems ni goms par bgyi | | srid zhi'i nyes dmigs shes pa yi/ /der 'dun pa dang bral ba dang*/ / sangs rgyas yon tan rjes dran pas/ /rtag tu de la 'dun pa dang*/ /bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba yis/ /gzhan gyi don la spro ba dang*/ /mi zhum pa dang mi skyo bas/ /'jug pa'i tshul la 'jug 'gyur ba/ /'di ni byang chub smon pa'i sems | | mthar phyin bgyid pa'i thabs chen lags/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsgrub pa/ /'jug pa mthar phyin bgyid pa ste/ /de yang rang gis sangs rgyas chos/ /rdzogs bgyid pha rol phyin pa drug /'di dag brtse bas kun bslang zhing | | 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog dang*/ /mi bshol chog mi shes pa dang*// gdul bya'i re ba yongs rdzogs shing*/ /de dag byang chub la sbyor ba/ /de ltar kun la ldan bgyis nas/ /dngos kun gtong bar 'dun pa yis/

/zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pa/ /rigs pa'i tshul gyis stsal bgyid pa/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ kha na ma tho med 'dun pas/ /nyes spaung dge ba bsgrub pa dang | | gzhan gyi don la nyer sbyor ba/ /'di ni tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ / 'khrug pa med par 'dun pa yis/ /mi mjed ji mi snyam pa dang*/ /nges par sems pas mi 'khrug pa/ /'di ni bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /dge ba sdud par spro ba yis/ /go cha sbyor dang mi zhum dang*/ /mi 'khrug pa dang chog mi shes/ / 'di ni brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /yid mi g.yo bar 'dun pa yis/ /yul rnams kun la sems bsdus nas/ /sems la sems rab 'jog byed pa/ /'di ni bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /thams cad shes par 'dun pa yis/ /kun rdzob shes shing de dpyad pas/ /rang bzhin med par rab shes pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rim bzhin ser sna tshul 'chal dang*/ khro dang le lo rnam g.yeng dang | | mi shes pa yi gnyen po ste/ /nyes pa thams cad 'jigs bgyid lags// 'byor dang bde 'gro gzugs bzang dang*/ /don kun grub dang yid zhi dang*/ / kun la kun nas mkhas gyur pa/ /gnas skabs kyi ni 'bras bu lags/ /dang po lnga yis bsod nams tshogs/ /rtag tu 'phel bar bgyid pa ste/ /de bzhin drug pa ye shes tshogs/ /yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa lags/ /gzhan yang lnga pa zhi gnas dang*/ /drug pa lhag mthong gyur pa ste/ /yid ni zhi bar gnas pa dang | | dpyad na lhag don mthong bar bshad/ /snga mas nyon mongs zhi bgyid cing | | ting 'dzin mngon shes dag par bgyid/ /phyi mas nyes kun drung 'byin zhing | | shes rab ye shes yongs dag bgyid/ /tshul khrims gnyis ka'i gzhi lags te/ /lhag ma gsum ni 'grub pa'i rkyen/ /rnam par dpyad na re re la'ang | | drug dang gnyis ka ldan gyur pas/ /de slad re re'ang drug dang ni/ / gnyis gnyis ldan par mkhyen bgyis nas/ /rtag tu goms par mdzod cig dang

| | de la sangs rgyas ring ma lags/ /sems can smin bgyid bsdu ba yi/ / dngos po rnam pa bzhi lags te/ /zang zing sbyin pas gdul bya kun/ /bos nas gnas skabs bde la 'god/ /snyan par smra bas pha rol phyin/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs bshad nas/ /don spyod pa yis bshad pa yi/ /sbyor ba dag la nyer sbyar te/ /bdag nyid don mthun zhugs pa yis/ /don la spro ba bskyed par bgyi | | dang po zang zing sgo nas te/ /gsum ni chos kyis sdud pa lags/ /de yang thog ma phan bgyid de/ /lhag ma gsum ni grol bgyid pas/ /gzhan gyi don gyi tshul thams cad/ /'di yi khongs su 'du ba lags/ /de ltar tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ /don gnyis dag la rab brtson pa'ang*/ /sgyu ma'i tshul gyis spyad bgyi zhing*/ /mi rtog rnal 'byor goms bgyis pas/ /dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul la/ /byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ /sgrib pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mngon sum du ni bgyid par 'gyur/ /bsod nams ye shes 'khor lo zung*/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i srog shing dang*/ /sdom pa rgya che'i rten dang ni/ /dran dang brtson 'grus ting 'dzin gyi/ /yan lag ldan pa'i rta mchog ni | | rim bzhin gcig gnyis gsum dag dang*/ /smon lam kha lo sgyur byed sogs | | tshogs par bgyis nas thar pa yi/ /cha mthun lam la 'jug bgyid pa | | de ni tshogs kyi lam zhes bgyi/ /de lta'i shing rta cher zhugs nas/ /dbang po'i yan lag lnga ldan dang*/ /stobs kyi yan lag lnga ldan dang*/ /glang chen gcig gnyis rim sbyar bas/ /bgrod pas nges 'byed cha mthun gyi/ /lam la nye bar zhugs gyur nas/ /'phags pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho cher/ /sbyor bas sbyor ba'i lam zhes bgyi/ /sa lam bgrod tshai'i mthong spang gi /nyes tshogs tshang tshing rab spangs nas/ /rgya mtshor nam mkha'i mdangs lhung ltar/ /mnyam gzhag blo dang chos kyi dbyings/ /ro gcig ye shes rgya mtsho yi/ /byang chub yan lag rin po che/

/rnam pa bdun ldan 'jug ngogs mchog /sngon chad ma mthong des mthong zhing | | nye bar zhugs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /'di ni mthong ba'i lam zhes bgyi/ /mi rtog ye shes gru bo che/ /'phags lam yan lag ba dan sogs/ /rnam pa brgyad kyis nyer brgyan par/ /zhugs nas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dus kyi rlung dang rjes mthun par/ /chos dbyings zhi ba'i 'jug ngogs la/ /bgrod pas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'dra'i/ /bsgoms pas spang pa'i nyes pa kun/ /spangs nas slob pa'i 'phags chos kyi/ /rin chen rnams la dbang sgyur bgyid/ /mthong don bsgoms pas goms bgy-id pas/ /'di ni bsgom pa'i lam zhes bgyi/ /de ltar sa dang rgya mtsho lta'i/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das lam las/ /nye bar brgal nas yid bzhin gyi/ /rin chen gling gi sgor zhugs mtshungs/ /bgrod pa'i lam gyi mthar son dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs kun 'joms pa dang*/ /yon tan mthar phyin bgyid pas na/ /mthar phyin pa yi lam zhes bgyi/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i lam de yang*/ /sa bcu dag gis phye ba lags/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chur mtshungs kyang*/ /gzhi yis so sor snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin grol bar chos mtshungs kyang*/ /gzhi dang yon tan dbang gis dbye/ /rang gi yon tan bskrun pa dang*/ /dpag yas 'byung po'i rten phyir sa/ /sangs rgyas nye dang sar zhugs dang | | sbyin la dga' bas rab dga'i sa/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa'i dri ma yis// ma gos phyir na dri ma med/ /lung gi chos kyi snang ldan zhing*/ /bzod mdangs ldan phyir 'od byed pa/ /rtog chos me yis nyes sreg cing*/ /brtson 'grus 'bar phyir 'od 'phro can/ /sbyang dka' gzhan sbyang bsam gtan gyis/ /rang sems bsrung phyir sbyang dka' ba/ /shes rab la brten 'khor 'das chos/ /mngon sum mthong bas mngon gyur sa/ /mtshan ma las ring thabs mchog gis/ khyad par 'phags pas ring du song*/ /rtog pa kun gyis mi bsgul zhing*/

/smon lam legs gnas mi g.yo'i sa/ /stobs chen yang dag rig pa bzhis/ /chos ston phyir na legs pa'i blo/ /ting 'dzin gzungs sprin ye shes mkhar/ /'du phyir de ni chos kyi sprin/ /de mthar ting 'dzin rdo rje yis/ /rin chen gter ni kha phye ste | | de mthus de bzhin gnas bsgyur nas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan mdzod | | sems can kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob par 'gyur | | mkha' la sprin dpung dengs pa ltar/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun spangs nas | | dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa/ /'di ni rang bzhin sku ru bshad/ / dpag med thabs dang thugs rje'i mthus/ /zhing dang ston pa 'khor dang dus/ / nges pa'i chos dang bde chen la/ /longs spyod longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /'di ni rang don bral ba yi/ /yon tan sum cu gnyis dang ldan/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen stobs dang*/ /las dang dbang po khams dang ni/ /mos dang kun 'gro dgod pa dang*/ /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ /'chi 'pho zag pa zad mkhyen pa/ /'di dag thub pa'i stobs bcu ste/ /sgrib dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ /phas rgol 'joms la rdo rje mtshungs/ /spang ba dang ni ye shes dang | | nges 'byung lam dang de yi gegs/ /yang dag ji bzhin ston pa la/ / kun tu 'jigs pa mi mnga'i phyir/ /mi 'jigs pa ni bzhi yin te/ /rgol ba sun 'byin bgyid pa dang*/ /gdul bya'i skye bo skyong ba la/ /rnam par bsgy-ings pa'i seng ge mtshungs/ /'khrul dang ca co mi mnga' dang*/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' mnyam par bzhag /tha dad pa yi 'du shes spangs/ /ma brtags btang snyoms mi mnga' dang*/ /'dun pa dang ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /dran dang shes rab nyams mi mnga'/ /rnam grol rnam grol ye shes ni/ /kun tu nyams pa mi mnga' dang | | sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi las/ /ye shes rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ / 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la/ /sgrib med ye shes gzigs 'jug pa/

/'di rnams thub pa'i ma 'dres chos/ /rnam pa bco brgyad nyid lags te/ /kun la khyab kyang thams cad kyis/ /ma gos phyir na mkha' dang mtshungs/ /'di ni bral ba'i yon tan te/ /rnam par phye na bgrang yas lags/ /dbang bcu la sogs gzhan bshad pa/ /'di yi nang du 'dus mkhyen mdzod/ /sku ni gzhan don rnam smin gyi/ /yon tan sum cu gnyis dang ldan/ /zhabs mnyam pa dang 'khor los mtshan | | rting pa yangs dang sor mo ring*/ /dra bas 'brel dang gzhon sha can/ / bdun mtho e na'i byin pa dang*/ /sba ba sbubs nub seng ge'i stod/ /thal gong rab rgyas dpung mgo zlum/ /phyag ring sku mchog rnam par dag /mgrin pa dri med dung lta bu/ /seng ge'i 'gram pa bzhi bcu'i tshems/ /thags bzang mnyam dang mche ba dkar/ /ljags ring ro bro'i mchog ldan dang*/ /ka la piṅka'i dbyangs dang ni/ /spyan mchog mthon mthing rdzi ma stug /mdzod spu rab tu dkar ba dang*/ /gtsug tor rab mtho bltar mi mthong*/ /pags pa srab cing gser mdog ldan/ /ba spu re re nas g.yas 'khrungs/ /dbu skra rin chen mthon mthing 'dra

| | n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /stobs po che yi mchog gyur pa/ /'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /dpe byad brgyad cu gang bshad pa/ /'di las rnam par phye ba lags/ /'di ni gzugs kyi sku yi dpal/ /ston ka yongs su dwangs pa la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /rgyu skar khrod na lham pa ltar/ / sa bcu brnyes pa'i dbus na lham/ /de nyid chu mtshor shar ba yis/ /byis pa dga' ba bskyed pa ltar/ /dge ba mthun par bsags pa la/ /mthun par snang bas de don bsgrub/ /'di ni theg chen man ngag gi /mdo yi rjes su 'brangs nas bshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de'i mthus/ /dpag yas 'gro ba'i bsod nams bzhin/ /sna tshogs snang bas don mdzad pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /rang bzhin sku ni chos dbyings kyi/ /ye shes mchog gis bsdus pa ste/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa ni/ /me long ye shes las gzhan min | | mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /de yi khyad par nyid lags shing*/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa yang dag bsdus/ /sku dang ye shes de dag kyang*/ /rim bzhin rten dang brten pa dang*/ /de bzhin rang don gzhan don dang*/ /phra dang rags par rnam par bzhag /sangs rgyas de yang zag med kyi/ /dbyings dang ro gcig nyid phyir dang*/ /mi zad rgyu las bskrun phyir dang | | mi mthun phyogs kun bcom phyir dang*/ /smon lam nye bar grub phyir dang | | kun tu dbang 'byor brnyes phy-ir dang*/ /mdzad pa'i yul yang mi zad phyir | | rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad pa lags/ /de phyir de yi bstan pa yang*/ /'jig rten khams su rtag tu gnas/ /de la snang dang mi snang med/ /'char ba dang ni nub pa dang*/ /'phel dang 'grib par gang mthong ba/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rtog pa dang | | las kyi dbang las byung ba ste/ /yul gyi mthu las de ma lags/ /ji ltar mkha' la snang ba dang*/ /mi snang ba dang nyi ma la/

/'char dang nub par snang lags kyang*/ /de lta de ma lags pa bzhin/ /des na rnal 'byor dag pa la | | rtag tu rgyal bas byin rlob cing*/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston la/ / rgyun du spyod pa ngo mtshar rmad/ /'di ni theg pa chen po yi/ /chos kyi gleng ba mdo tsam lags/ /rgyas par gzhan du mkhyen bgyi ste/ /bla na med pa'i don chen slad | | mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*/ /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gis 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes gsungs don gyi rim pa ltar/ /bdag gis 'di ni brjod pa lags/ /pha rol gzigs pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /shin tu mkhas pa de dag gis/ /rnam grangs du mas chos kyi tshul/ /yang yang gsal bar mdzad zin mod/ /nyung zhing gsal bas nyid thugs la/ /kun nas gdams par bgyi phyir dang*/ /gzhan dag la yang phan bgyi'i slad/ /bdag gis kyang ni 'dir brjod do/ /bdag blo byis pa'i ngang tshul dang*/ /shes bya rgya cher ma sbyangs dang*/ /glo bur bgyis phyir 'dir nongs pa/ /blo chen rnams kyis rtag bzod mdzod/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun | | 'jig rten tshul lugs legs spyad nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i sgor zhugs te/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur cig /rgyal bu ji big la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba me pho stag gi lo/ gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad la | 'phags pas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa nyis brgya dang bzhi bzhugs so// //༄༅/ /rgyal bu mang ga la la gtam du bya ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bkra shis phreng ba ) bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal bu maṃ ga ga la la gtam du bya ba/ bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bkra shis yid 'ong dpal gyi sku mnga' zhing*/ /bkra shis 'gag med kun tu 'jug pa'i gsung*/

/bkra shis mkhyen brtses rol pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /bkra shis phun tshogs sangs rgyas dpal la 'dud/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu bkra shis mtshan ldan pas/ /nye bar skul nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang*/ /lung dang rigs pa yis kyang rnam dpyad nas/ /bkra shis rnam par spel nas dbul bar bgyi | | 'di ltar khyod kyis brnyes pa'i mtho ris kyi/ /dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa gang lags pa/ /nyid kyis rang dbang bsnams nas byon min te/ /sku yang gzhan gyis bskyed nas bskrun phyir ro/ /gnam dang lha dang phywa zhes grags pa yi/ /byed pos bgyis pa min te rtag pa dang*/ /byed por 'gal zhing 'jig rten don phal cher/ /rtsol ba'i rjes su 'brang bar mthong phyir ro/ /de slad 'jig rten bde sdug phal che ba/ /las las byung zhes thub pas gang gsungs te | | rigs pa yis kyang grub pa de bas na/ /gang gis bde bgyis dge ba'i las rnams la/ /gus par mdzod cig lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ /yab yum brgyud par bcas dang de bzhin du/ /gang gis cung zad phan bgyis de dag la'ang | | 'phral du drin la lan du blan par bgyi/ /de yis sngon gyi dge ba nyer 'phel zhing*/ /nyid kyi rjes su gzhan yang rjes 'brangs pas/ /bdag gzhan kun gyi dge 'phel de las ni/ /phyogs mthar gtugs pa'i bkra shis 'byung lags grang*/ /rigs dang gzugs dang shes rab longs spyod dang*/ /dbang phyug nad med pa dang tshe ring ba/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun du thub pa yis/ / rab tu bka' stsal de dag bskyang bar bgyi/ /rigs kyi phul du khyod ni nyer 'khrungs mod/ /'on kyang mdzad spyaud dge bas dge bgyi ste/ /spyod pa med na rigs don nyams so zhes/ /gtsug lag dag las legs par 'byung phyir ro/ / 'jig rten pa yi dge spyod de yang ni/ /chang mi 'thung dang 'tsho ba dag pa dang*/ / rnam mi 'tshe dang mchod 'os mchod pa dang*/ /nyam thag sbyin pas rjes su skyang ba'o zhes/

/'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas gsungs shing*/ /gzhan yang khrel yod ngo tshas legs bsdams nas/ /kun gyis smad pa'i las las ldog pa dang | | bsngags pa'i las rnams dag la rab brtson zhing*/ /gzhan dag gis ni sngon chad ma bgyis pa/ /gang zhig mthong ba'i ba spu ldang 'gyur zhing*/ /kun la mi gnod kun tu phan 'gyur ba/ /gtsug lag mchod rten kun dga' ra ba dang | | phongs pa rnams kyi bsti gnas legs bgyis pas/ /grags pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo bgyid pa/ /de 'dra kho na lags pa de slad du/ /de 'dras nyid kyi cho 'brang gsal bar mdzod/ /rang gis nyer spyad bya phyir khang bzangs dang | | nye ba'i khang bzangs khrus kyi khang pa dang*/ /rta babs skyed mos tshal dang bkod ma sogs/ /shin tu rgya chen rmad du byung ba gang*/ /mang po'i tshogs kyis 'bad nas sgrub bgyid pas/ /gnas skabs dga' dang ngo mtshar skyed lags kyang*/ /rang gis rang gi bsnyen bkur lhag bgyis pa/ /sngon bsags pa yi dge ba bas bgyid cing*/ /slar zhing sred pa 'phel 'gyur de slad du/ /de 'dra'i tshul la shin tu bag yod mdzod/ /ci bder grub la kha na ma tho med/ / gzhan gyis bstabs pa tshul bzhin spyad par bgyi/ /mtho ris 'byor pa rnams kyi gzhi dang ni/ /gru ltar srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /phyin par bgyid pa'i rten yang gzugs lags pas/ /dbang po gsal dang lus stobs rgyas phyir dang | | bde la yun ring reg par gnas bgyi'i phyir/ /yul dus gnas skabs dag dang rjes 'brel ba'i/ /gsol zas sman sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis/ / chab kyi pad+ma bzhin du bskyang bar mdzod/ khrus kyis dri ma sbyangs nas mdangs phyung zhing*/ /ha cang sgeg min gos gsar gyis klubs kyis/ /dri bzang me tog sar pas mdzes byas la/ /lha yi dpal yang 'jug ces lugs las 'byung*/ / shes rab bdag gzhan gsal bgyid sgron ma ste/ /rgol ba'i spobs pa 'joms byed dpa' bo lags/

/snyan pa'i grags pa kun tu g.yo bgyid pa/ /de slad khyod kyis shes rab spel bar mdzod/ /skyes thob shes rab sngon gyi las rjes 'brang | | sbyangs thob shes rab rang gi rtsol ba la/ /rag las phyir na shin tu brtson pa yis/ /mkhyen rab gsal ba gsal bar mdzad du gsol/ /tshad mthar thug pa lus kyi yon tan yang*/ /sgyu rtsal mkhan bzhin sbyangs pas gzhan dag las/ khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan gzhan dag gis/ /bsngags par bgyid pa mngon du gzigs lags na/ /shes rab gzugs can ma lags de slad du/ /tshad ma mchis phyir de yi yon tan yang*/ /gzhal du ma mchis phyir na thub pa bzhin/ /gzhal med yon tan dpal gyis 'byor par mdzod/ /de yang rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos 'ga'/ /nyi ma re re tshig re gzung byas na/ / grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du/ /ring por mi thogs mkhas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las 'byung bas na/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis 'dzin dang gsan pa dang*/ /rnam par dpyod pa zhib mos legs dpyad pas/ / mkhyen rab yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ /gang yod na ni bdag gzhan phun tshogs shing*/ /gnas skabs dga' dang bde ba 'phel byed la/ / thabs kyis zin na srid zhi'i dpal skyed pa'i/ /longs spyod chud mi gsan zhing spel bar bya/ /gang zhig bung bas sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du/ /rang gis 'bad pa chen po nyer bsags nas/ /spyad du med par gzhan gyis 'phrog bgyid pa/ /phongs pas phongs pa bsgrub pa'i longs spyod lags/ /gcan gzan khro bos ri dwags rnams la lta/ /brtse ba med par gzhan la nyer phrogs nas/ /spyod dang sbyin par bgyid pa dug bcas kyi/ kha zas bzhin du sdug bsngal skyed par bgyid/ /rtsol ba med par gzhan gyis nyer bstabs pas/ /mdzod dang sa yi tha gru rgyas gyur kyang | | cung zad spyod dang sbyin par mi bgyid pa'i/ /'byor pa de ni rgya mtsho'i rin chen mtshungs/ /thog mar ci lta'i tshul gyis rnyed kyang rung*/

/bar du rang gis ci bder spyod bgyid cing*/ /gzhan dag la yang tshul bzhin yongs gtong ba | | 'byor pa de ni lha yi dpal dang 'dra/ /gang zhig dang po lhun gyis grub gyur nas/ /rang gi cha tsam las ni mi spyod par/ /mchod 'os mchod dang dman pa legs skyong ba'i/ /longs spyod de ni mi zad gter chen lags/ /de slad srid 'bangs zhi la bka' drin gyi/ /sa bon yul dang 'tsham par legs stsal nas | | tshul bzhin 'chos pa'i so nam rab bgyis te/ khrims su bca' ba dam pos bsrungs bgyis nas/ /de las de yi dpal 'byor gang bskrun las/ / bzhon las 'o ma dang ni sā la yi/ /shing las spos bzhin dus su ran pa dang*/ / 'tshe med sdud dang 'tsham pa'i sho gam gyis/ /bang mdzod dam pa rnam par rgyas bgyis te/ /rang gis tshul bzhin dgyes rgur spyod pa dang*/ /gzhan la mchod cing lhug par legs gnang bas/ /'di dang phyi ma'i dga' bde 'phel bar mdzod | | tshong dang skyed dang bla la sogs pa yis/ /'byor pa spel bgyid phal pa'i tshul lags pas/ /de 'dras 'tsho ba de dag bag rkyang nas/ /'tshe ba med par 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan tshwa la sogs sems can spyi mthun gyi/ / las las grub pa'i yo byad gang lags pa/ /de kun skye rgu so so'i rtsol ba yis | | btsal nas spyod par stsal na ji ltar dgongs/ /chang dang chu dang snyug ma la sogs pa/ /rang gi rtsol bas bsgrubs te btsongs nas su/ /'tsho bgyid de dag zho shas 'tsho ba zhes/ /lung las bshad bzhin gnang bar rigs lags grang | | gos dang rgyan sogs nye bar spyod pa'i zong*/ /sngon chad med pa 'ga' zhig lha de yi/ /sku ring la ni byung zhes skye bo yis/ /kun tu bsngags 'gyur spel na 'thad par 'tshal/ /dge sbyong bram ze sogs kyi smon lam dang*/ /shes nyan ldan pas rig pas khyod bkur zhing*/ /'gro mang dga' bgyid de dag bca' sogs kyis/ /'tshe ba med na 'jig rten dger 'gyur lags/

/pad+mo yongs su rgyas pas khebs pa'i mtshor/ /bskrad kyang ngang pa'i tshogs 'du ji bzhin du/ / nyid kyi yul 'khor 'tshe med 'byor ldan par/ /skye rgu ngang gis 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /dbang phyug phun sum tshogs la gzhan dag gis/ /bar du gcod par mi nus de yis ni/ /'gro mang bskyab par nus pa de slad du/ /dbang phyug rnam par spel bgyi de yang ni/ /'gums dang gzhu (《 zha 》 'khru ) dang de bzhin gshe ba dang*/ /dbrog pa la sogs bsdigs nas btsan bcings dang*/ /ldan par ston tai gdug pa'i sbrul mtshungs pa'i/ kha na ma tho bcas pa spang bar bgyi/ / gang zhig rang gis drang po'i tshul spyad cing*/ /drang zhing rigs pa'i tshul gyis gzhanabacos pas/ /mi rigs spyod pa ngang gis 'jig 'gyur zhing*/ /rigs lam 'jug bgyid dbang phyug dam pa lags/ /nad med pa ni bde ba'i mchog lags pas/ /nyid kyang bsnyun mi mnga' bar bgyid slad du/ /nad 'phel ba dang lus zungs rgud bgyid pa'i/ /zas dang btung ba gnas dang kun spyod sogs | | cha shas kyis ni rab tu spang bgyi zhing*/ /nad mi skyed pa'am zhi bar bgyid pa dang*/ khams dang dbang po rgyas shing gsal bgyid pa'i/ /gnas dang yo byad spyod lam bsten par mdzod/ /nad pa rnams la sman dang kha zas dang*/ / gos dang stan sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang*/ /sngags sogs phan bgyid rig pa sna tshogs kyis/ /byams dang sri zhu bcas pas phan par mdzod/ /sman gyi bla dang 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ /lha mo ri khrod lo ma can sogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor dang ni bzlas brjod brtson bgyid pa/ /yul 'khor dag tu mang du gzhug tu gsol | | gang gi dbang gis sna tshogs nad skyed pa/ /mkha' 'gro sha za la sogs 'byung po'i yid/ /zhi bar bgyi slad mchod sbyin bgyid pa yang*/ / rim gror bcas te bka' yis bsgo bar mdzod/ /de dag gis ni nyid sku bde ba dang | | nyid kyi chabs 'og mchis pa'i 'gro kun yang*/
