/byams pa'i stobs kyis srid 'bangs ji bzhin du/ /nad dang 'tshe med bde bar gnas gyur lags | | tshe ring gyur na rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /phal cher 'grub 'gyur bde la yun ring du*/ /reg par gnas shing chos don tshol bas kyang*/ /go skabs mchi slad sku tshe bsring bar bgyi/ /sman dang ting nge 'dzin dang gsang sngags sogs | | gang zhig gis ni tshe yi gegs sel zhing*/ /tshe 'phel byed par gsungs pa de dag la/ /bsgrub pa nan tan gyis ni mdzad du gsol/ /'chi bar nges pa'i srog ni bslu ba dang*/ /'gro la srog gi mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang*/ / gzhan dag srog gcod pa las ldog pa yis/ /tshe yi dpal 'byor rgyas par 'gyur ba lags/ /tshe dpag med dang rnam rgyal la sogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor dang ni bzlas pa brtson bgyid pa/ /mang po bkur stir bcas pa nyer bsten pas/ / sku tshe kun du bsring bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngon gyi dge spyad dang ni smon lam gyis | | mtho ris dpal bdun khyod kyis gang brnyes pa/ /'di ltar gsol ba'i thabs tshul 'di yis ni/ /de dag rgyas mdzod mngon par mtho ba lags/ /de ltar 'jig rten pa yi dpal gyis ni/ /'jig rten 'dir ni phun sum tshogs gyur nas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal gyis bdag gzhan kun/ /'byor par bgyi slad chos lam bsten du gsol/ /chos de'ang brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston zhing*/ /ngag tshig dri med sgrub byed gsum dang ldan/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i 'bras 'byin pa/ /nyid lags gzhan ni gzhan du mkhyen par mdzod// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang ni/ /chos kun bdag med zag bcas sdug bsngal la/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi zhing bde ba'o zhes/ /phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi yang bka' stsal to/ /de dag thub dbang nyid kyi bdag rkyen las/ /byung ba gang de la ni bka' zhes bgyi/ /gang zhig thub pas gsungs pa 'ba' zhig gis/ / dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis byas/

/thar pa sgrub pa'i lam dang rjes 'brel bar/ /dgongs pa 'grel bgyid gang de bstan bcos te/ /'di dag lung gi chos lags de bsgoms pas/ /goms pa lhag par son pa rtogs pa'i chos/ /de dag chags pa bral bgyid lam dang ni/ /de yis chags bral bgyid pa 'gog chos lags/ /chos de rnams dang dpyad bgyi gzhan rnams la

| | gang zag tshig dang drang don rnam shes la/ /ming don chos don nges pa'i don dang ni/ /ye shes rton pa rton pa bzhir gsungs pas/ /gnyis po dag la gsum gyi rnam dpyad nas/ /bzhi la rton zhing tshul bzhi la zhugs pas/ /thob par bgyi pa'i chos lnga rim bzhin du/ /thob bgyid de ni nges par legs pa'i chos | | 'di yis brgyad dang rnam gsum mngon du bgyid/ /de yang theg pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa las/ /theg pa chung ngu'i chos kyi tshul gyis ni/ /rang nyid zhi bar bgyid pa lags mod kyi/ /sangs rgyas thob par bgyid pa ma lags pas | | bsnyen gnas sogs la ci nus brtson par mdzod/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro tshe ring lha/ /kla klor skyes dang log par lta ba dang*/ /rgyal bas stong par skyes dang lkugs pa ste/ /mi khom gnas brgyad dag las mthar bgyi'i slad | | yid gang 'dod chags bcas dang zhe sdang dang*/ /gti mug bcas pa yis ni kun bslang nas/ /srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem pa dang*/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang*/ /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ /nag po'i las bcur gsungs pa spang bgyis nas/ /mir gyur yul dbus skyes dang dbang po tshang*/ /gnas la dad dang las mtha' ma log dang*/ / zhing der sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsung dang*/ /bsten pa gnas dang rjes sgrub yod pa dang*/ /de yi brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ /'byor pa bcu pos kun nas 'byor bgyi'i slad/ /ma chags pa dang zhe sdang med pa dang*/ /gti mug med pas kun nas bslang pa yi/ /srog la byams dang longs spyod gtong ba dang*/ / ma chags pa dang bden par smra ba dang*/ /mthun par byed dang snyan dang don ldan smra | | chog shes phan 'dod yang dag lta ba ste/ /dkar po'i las kyi lam bcur gsungs pa la/ /rnam pa kun tu 'bad pas bsgrub tu gsol/ /gzhan yang yi ge 'dri dang mchod pa dang*/ /sbyin dang nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*/

/'chad dang kha ton sems dang sgom pa ste/ /chos spyod bcu yang ci nus dag tu mdzod/ / theg chen bdud rtsi'i sgo mo'ang skyabs 'gro zhes/ /thub pas bka' stsal de yang 'khor ba dang*/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bdag gzhan bskyab phyir dang*/ / yul la dad pas de 'dra bgyi slad du/ /skyabs kyi gtso bo'i go 'phang brnyes kyi bar | | phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /theg mchog la sogs dam chos thams cad dang*/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun la skyabs gsol nas(《 zha 》 dang ) / /skyabs ma yin la skyob par mi 'dzin zhing*/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams dang 'grogs pa dang*/ /de las dam pa'i chos rnams gsan pa dang | | chos bzhin bsgrub la kun tu brtson par mdzod/ /snying rje chen po'i rgyu las byung gyur zhing*/ /yang dag shes pa'i rtogs pas dbang byas pa'i/ /spro ba che dang rtsom pa che bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems mchog yang yang bskyed bgyis nas | | nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo la sogs pa las/ /ji ltar bka' stsal bzhin du bslab bya rnams/ /mkhyen zhing bslab par mdzod cig ci gsungs pa'i | | phan yon thams cad myur du brnyes 'gyur lags/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod nad dang ni/ /las dang nyon mongs kun 'byung nad rgyu dang*/ / 'gog pa nad med bde bar gnas pa dang*/ /lam ni 'tsho ba'i sman 'drar mkhyen bgyis nas/ /thugs 'byung ba dang kun nas spang ba dang*/ /shin tu 'dun dang bsgrub la nan tan mdzod/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes gsungs | | chos rnams kun gyi sdom yang 'di lags so/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi lags bsags pa yi/ /mtha' 'dzad mthon po'i mtha' ni dma' ba dang*/ /'tsho mtha' 'chi dang 'dus mtha' 'bral ba na// 'khor ba'i mtha' bzhir gsungs pa de dag las/ /bdag nyid ∶bsnyaings shing gzhan la thugs brtse dang*/ /bdag nyid rgal nas gzhan dag sgrol ba dang | | bdag nyid (《

zha 》 - bsnyaings shing bdag nyid ) thar nas gzhan dag drang du gsol | | ma rig pa las 'du byed de las ni/ /rnam par shes pa de las ming dang gzugs/ /de las skye mched drug 'byung de las reg /de las tshor dang de las sred pa 'byung*/ /de las len pa len las srid pa dang*/ /srid las skye ba skye las na dang rga/ /'chi dang mya ngan smre sngags yid mi bde/ /sdug bsngal phung po brgyud mar 'byung 'gyur zhing*/ /dngos po rnam par dpyad pas ma rig 'gag | de yis 'du byed la sogs rim bzhin du/ /nye bar 'gags nas sdug bsngal mthar byed pa/ /de dag rten cing 'byung ba'i tshul gnyis lags/ /ji ltar snang ba 'di ni kun rdzob ste/ /de yi rang bzhin spros bral don dam lags// de don dpyad cing sgom pa goms bgyis pas/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i chos la dbang bsgyur bgyid/ /'dod chags la sogs thar lam sgrib byed dang*/ / 'khor gsum rtog pas kun mkhyen la sgrib pa'i/ /sgrib pa de dag so so'i gnyen po dang*/ /lam gyi yon tan dam par bsgyur du gsol/ /mthun par gyur pa'i yul du dge ba yi/ /bshes dang 'grogs nas sgrub pa nan tan du/ / mdzad nas smon lam dam pa legs 'debs pa'i/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan par mdzod/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed bde dang mi bde dang*/ /snyan dang mi snyan bstod smad chos brgyad po/ /mgo snyoms pa la goms mdzod de dag kun/ /dge ba'i rkyen 'gyur zhi bar bgyid pa'ang lags/ /sgrub byed gtong dang tshul khrims gnas skabs 'bras/ /lha dang mthar thug 'bras bu dang ni skyabs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nyid lags pas/ /so so'i yon tan rjes su dran par mdzod | | dad dang gtong dang tshul khrims thos pa dang*/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab rnams/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang thob bgyid de srid du'ang*/ / dpal dang bde ba skyed pas 'phags pa yi/ /nor bdun zhes byar 'phags mchog gis gsungs pas/

/nor mchog de dag gis ni rtag par nyid/ /'byor par mdzod cig nyid la rten pa yi/ /skye bo gzhan yang 'byor par 'gyur lags grang | | sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab 'di dag srid zhi yi/ /pha rol phyin bgyid pha rol phyin drug gis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i pha rol gshegs par mdzod/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa yi/ /sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi po stsal bgyi zhing*/ /mi dge sdom dang dge ba'i chos sdud dang*/ /sems can don byed khrims la bslab par bgyi/ /mi 'byed ji mi snyam dang nges sems pa'i/ /bzod pa gsum gyis nyid thugs zhi bar mdzod/ /go cha dang ni tshul bzhin rab zhugs dang*/ /ma zhum mi 'khrug chog mi shes pa yi/ /brtson 'grus lnga la kun du brtson bgyis pa/ /dkar po'i chos kun yongs su bsdu bgyi zhing*/ /spong dang bsgrub pa'i bsam gtan rnam gnyis kyis | | thugs zhi ba dang yon tan rnams 'phel mdzod/ /thos bsam sgom las byung ba'i blo gsum gyis/ /kun rdzob don dam shes pa'i shesarab gnyis/ /rnam par bskyed nas chos rnams kun la dbang*/ /yongs su sgyur ba'i dbang phyug dam par mdzod/ /stong pa mtshan ma med dang smon pa med/ /'dus ma byas rnams rnam thar sgo bzhi ste/ /'di ltar shes pas shes rab pha rol phyin/ /de ltar mnyam 'jog gang de bsam gtan lags/ /thabs mkhas smon lam stobs dang ye shes bzhi/ /drug po re re la yang tshang bgyi zhing*/ /mthar ni bzhi po so sor bsgrub bgyis pas/ /sa rnams bcu po mthar phyin bgyis pa lags// zang zing snyan par smra dang don mthun dang*/ /don spyod ces bgyi bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis/ /'gro mang bsdus nas don chen mdzad du gsol/ /de nyid nyid kyi don gyi phul yang lags/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gsum/ / 'phags lam bgrod la rkang mig dang mtshungs shing*/ /dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad 'dir 'dus pas/

/shin tu 'bad pa yis ni bslab par mdzod/ / dmigs dang dmigs pa med la mnyam 'jog pa'i/ /zhi gnas kyis ni ting 'dzin bsgrub bgyi zhing*/ /don la rnam par dpyod pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /shes rab ye shes yongs su dag par bgyi/ /spros dang bcas pas bsod nams tshogs dang ni/ /de bzhin spros pa med pa'i ye shes dang*/ /zung du 'jug pas zung 'jug 'phel bgyis pas/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor par mdzod/ /'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyid rmugs rgod 'gyod dang*/ /the tshom zhes bgyi sgrib pa rnam lnga po/ /bsam gtan bde ba thob pa'i gegs lags pas/ /de dag cha shas kyis ni spang bgyis nas/ /yul gyi mchog la dad pa rnam gsum dang*/ /dman pa la ni snying rje gsum dang yang*/ /byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gsum po la/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i ting 'dzin goms par mdzod/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms te/ /tshad med bzhi yi bsgom pa goms bgyis na/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa dpe med rgya chen dang*/ /rgyal ba'i tshad med bzhi yang thob par bgyid/ /rtog dang dpyod dang bcas dang dga' bder bcas/ /bde ba tsam dang btang snyoms yongs dag pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin de gzugs khams gtogs pa yi/ /bsam gtan bzhi po dag dang de bzhin du/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ /ci yang med dang yod min med min te/ /gzugs med gtogs pa'i skye mched rnam bzhi dang | | 'gog pa dang ni snyoms 'jug rnam dgu dang*/ /gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la blta ba dang*/ /sdug pa mngon byas mkha' dang rnam shes dang*/ / ci yang med dang yod min med min dang*/ /'gog pa zhes bya'i rnam thar brgyad po dang*/ /ting 'dzin yul du phyi nang zad par ni/ /sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dang | | dmar po dkar po nam mkha' rnam shes su/ /bsgom pa zhes bgyi zad par bcu dang ni/ /gzugs su 'du shes ldan pa phyi yi gzugs/

/phra dang rags dang gzugs med 'du shes pas/ /chung dang chen po'i gzugs dang de bzhin du | | sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la/ /lta zhing zil gnon skye mched brgyad rnams la/ /mnyam gzhag rnal 'byor goms pas so so yi/ /spang bya'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing rab bsregs nas/ /ting 'dzin snang ba dam pa thob par mdzod | | lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems rnams la/ /mi gtsang sdug bsngal bdag med mi rtag dang*/ /rang bzhin med par mkhyen nas dran par mdzod/ / 'di bzhis tshogs lam chung ngu bgrod par bgyid/ /dge ba skyed dang srung dang de bzhin du/ /mi dge mi skyed pa dang spong ba ste/ /brtson 'grus gtogs pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhis/ /tshogs lam 'bring po mthar phyin mdzad du gsol/ / 'dun dang dpyod dang dran pa dang ni sems/ /ting 'dzin rtogs pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhis/ /tshogs lam chen po'i 'jug ngogs bgrod par bgyid/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /shes rab dbang po lnga ste 'di dag gis | | dge ba'i chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /drod dang rtse mo mthar phyin bgyid pa lags/ /de dag stobs su gyur pa stobs lnga ste/ /lam gyi mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms bgyid cing*/ /bzod dang chos mchog dag ste de rnams kyis/ /sbyor ba'i lam rnams bgrod par mdzad du gsol/ /dran dang chos rab 'byed dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /dga' dang yongs sbyangs ting 'dzin btang snyoms te/ /byang chub yan lag bdun gyis mthong ba'i lam/ /kun tu gzigs nas rnam grol brnyes par mdzod/ /de tshe 'tsho bas gtugs dang 'chi ba dang*/ /mi bsngags ngan 'gror 'khor gyis 'jigs pa ste/ /bag tsha'i gnas lnga po 'di rnam spangs nas/ /'phags mchog rnams dang spyod yul gcig gyur lags | | yang dag lta dang 'tsho dang rtsol ba dang*/ /dran dang ting 'dzin ngag dang las kyi mtha'/ /rtog pa dang ni 'phags pa'i lam brgyad kyis/

/sgom pa'i lam rnams mthar phyin bgyid pa lags/ /lam de'ang sa bcus rab tu phye ba ste | | rab dga' dri med 'od byed 'od 'phro dang*/ /sbyang dka' mngon gyur ring du song ba dang*/ /mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros chos sprin no/ /rab dgar gnas pas dus gcig nyid la ni/ /ting 'dzin brgya thob de la 'jug pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas brgya mthong de yi byin rlabs rig /zhing brgyar 'gro zhing 'jig rten khams brgya bsgul/ /de brgya snang byed 'gro brgya smin par byed/ /bskal pa brgyar gnas sngon dang phyi mthar 'jug /chos brgya 'byed cing lus brgya ston pa dang*// lus re'ang byang chub sems dpa' brgya phrag gi /'khor gyis yongs su bskor bar ston pa ste/ /'di dag yon tan brgya phrag cu gnyis lags/ /de dag dri ma med la gnas pa nas/ /bcu pa'i bar la gnas pa'i rim bzhin du/ /stong dang 'bum dang bye ba phrag brgya dang*/ /bye ba phrag stong bye ba phrag 'bum dang*/ /bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum dag dang ni/ /'jig rten 'bum gyi rdul dang mnyam pa dang | | de bzhin 'jig rten grangs med 'bum rdul dang*/ /'jig rten mtha' yas rdul dang mnyam pa thob/ /de mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gnas ngan len gyi dri ma kun spangs nas/ /bgrod par bgyi ba'i lam gyi mthar gtugs pa/ /'di ni mthar phyin pa yi lam zhes bgyi/ /de tshe bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib spangs nas/ /dbyings dang ye shes kun tu ro gcig pa/ /'di ni spang ba phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /de nyid rang bzhin chos kyi sku yang lags/ / zag med dbyings las rnam par ma g.yos bzhin/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs smon lam legs sgrub pas/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par// ye shes dag pa'i snang ba la dmigs pa/ /'og min zhes bya'i zhing khams 'jig med par/ /chos kyi sprin la gnas pa rgya mtsho yi/ /tshogs la theg mchog kho na'i chos gsung zhing*/

/phyi ma'i mur thug med pa'i dus kyi bar/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang thabs cig tu/ /zag pa med pa'i dga' bde la spyod pa'i | | sku ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lags te/ /lus gnas gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan dang rus sbal zhabs/ /phyag dang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang*/ /phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags/ /thub pa'i sku yi bdun dag mtho ba dang*/ /sor mo ring dang rting yangs sku che drang*/ /zhabs 'bur mi mngon spu ni gyen du phyogs/ /byin pa e na ya 'dra phyag ring mdzes/ /mdom gyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog / pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang*/ /spu ni re re nas g.yas legs 'khrungs dang*/ /zhal mdzod spus brgyan ro stod seng ge'i (《 zha 》 ge ) 'dra/ /phyag gi dpung pa'i mgo zlum thal gong rgyas/ /ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog nyid du snang | | sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /gtsug tor 'bur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang*/ /tshangs dbyangs 'gram pa seng ge'i 'dra dang tshems/ /shin tu dkar dang tshad mnyam thags bzang dang*/ /grangs ni bzhi bcu tham par tshang ba dang | | spyan ni mthon mthing spyan rji ba mchog gi /'dra ba'i mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis kyis mtshan/ /sen mo zangs mdog snum zhing dbyibs mtho zlum/ / sor mo rab tu rgyas shing byin gyis phra/ /rtsa mi mngon dang rtsa mdud med pa dang*// long bu mi mngon zhabs mthil kun nas mnyam/ /seng ge glang chen ngang pa'i rgyal po dang*/ khyu mchog stabs dang g.yas kyi phyogs nas gshegs/ /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags pa'i sku/ /byi dor byas 'drar rab mdzes rim pa 'tsham/ /gtsang 'jam rnam dag mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /sku yi kho lag yangs shing rab tu bzang*/ /gom snyoms spyan ni rnam dag gzhon sha chags

| | ma zhum rab rgyas shin tu grims pa'i sku/ /yan lag rnam 'byes gzigs pa rab rib med/ /dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs pa yi sku/ /phyal ni phyal le pa dang lte ba zab/ /g.yas su 'khyil dang kun nas rab tu mdzes/ / kun spyod rab gtsang sku la sme ba med/ /phyag ni shing bal lta bur shin tu 'jam | | phyag gi ri mo mdangs gsal zab cing ring*/ /zhal ni ha cang mi ring 'tsham (《 zha 》 'jam ) pa dang*/ /zhal sgros bim ba ltar dmar ljags mnyen srab/ / zangs mdog ltar dmar 'brug gi sgra dang ni/ /gsung mnyen mche ba zlum rnor rab dkar mnyam/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho rnam par dag /spyan yangs rdzi ma rab stug dkar nag 'byes/ /smin tshugs ring 'jam snum zhing spu ni mnyam | | phyag rgyas snyan mnyam ma nyams dpral ba 'byes/ /dbyes che dbu rgyas dbu skra bung ba'i mdog /stug 'jam ma 'dzings mi bshor dri zhim dang*/ /phyag zhabs g.yung drung dpal gyi be'us mtshan/ /'di dag dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste | | de 'dras mgon de'i sku mchog mdzes pa lags/ /ngag gnas gyur pa 'gag pa med pa'i gsung*/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus brgyan pa ste/ / mnyen dang 'jam dang yid 'ong yid du 'thad/ /dag dang dri med gsal dang 'jebs pa dang*/ /mnyan 'os mi tshugs snyan dang dul ba dang*/ /mi rtsub mi brlang rab dul ∶rnam par (《 zha 》 rna bar ) 'bab/ /lus tshim sems tshim yid dga' byed pa dang*/ /dga' bde skyed dang gdung sel kun shes byed/ /rnam par rig bya rnam gsal dga' ba skyed/ /mngon par dga' dang kun shes rnam rig byed/ /rigs pa dang ni 'brel dang zlos skyon bral/ /seng ge glang chen 'brug gi sgra dbyangs dang*/ /klu dbang dri za ka la piṅka dang*/ /tshangs dbyangs shang shang te'u'i sgra ltar snyan/ /lha dbang dbyangs dang rnga sgra lta bur brjid/ /ma khengs mi dma' sgra kun rjes zhugs dang*/ /tshig zur ma chag ma tshang med pa dang | | ma zhum mi zhan rab tu dga' ba dang*/

khyab dang tha bar bcas pa'i ched dang ni/ /rgyun chags 'brel dang sgra kun rdzogs byed dang*/ /dbang po tshim byed ma smad mi 'gyur dang*/ /ma rtags pa dang nye 'khor kun tu grags/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa yi/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul ston par mdzad/ / yid gnas gyur pa gnyis su med pa'i thugs/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen pa ya | | ye shes gnyis dang rten las kyis phye bas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang me long lta bur dang*/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor kun tu rtog /bya grub zhes bya'i ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /skyon gnas gyur pa zag med yon tan te/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu so bdun dang*/ /tshad med pa ni rnam bzhi po dang*/ /∶gzugs can gzugs med gzugs la lta ba dang*/ /sdug pa mngon byas mkha' dang rnam shes dang*/ /ci yang med dang yod min med min dang*/ /'gog pa zhes bgyi'i rnam thar brgyad po dang*/ /de bzhin snyoms par 'jug pa rnam dgu dang*/ /sa chu me rlung sngon po ser po dang*/ /dmar po dkar po mkha' dang rnam shes su/ / sgom pa zhes bgyi zad par cu dang ni/ /gzugs su 'du shes ldan pas phyi yi gzugs | | phra dang rags dang gzugs dang 'du shes pas/ /chung dang chen po'i gzugs dang de bzhin du/ /sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la/ /lta zhing zil gyis gnon pa zil gnon brgyad/(《 zha 》 rnam thar brgyad dang mthar gyi snyoms 'jug dgu | | zad par bcu dang zil gnon skye mched brgyad/ /mthar phyin lhun gyis grub pa brnyes pa dang*/ ) / bdag nyid nyon mongs med pas gzhan dag gi /nyon mongs 'joms bgyid nyon mongs med pa dang*/ /smon pas shes bya'i chos kun lhun grub tu/ /mkhyen nas the tshom kun gcod smon mkhyen dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul lha yi mig dang rna ba dang | | pha rol sems dang sngon gyi gnas dang ni/ /zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa zhes bgyi ba'i/ /mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug dang ni/

/bshad bya chos dang don dang 'chad byed ni/ /nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa zhes bgyi ba/ /so so yang dag rig pa rnam bzhi dang*/ /rten dang dmigs pa thugs dang ye shes te/ / yongs su dag pa bzhi dang de bzhin du/ /tshe dang sems dang yo byad las dang ni | | skye ba mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /ye shes chos la dbang ba zhes bgyi ba/ /dbang bcu dag tu gsungs pa de dag dang*/ /gnas las khams mos dbang po kun 'gro'i lam/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dgod pa dang*/ / sngon gnas rjes dran 'chi 'pho skye ba dang*/ /zag pa zad mkhyen 'di dag stobs bcu lags/ /ye shes brnyes dang spang bya spang ba dang*/ /nges 'byung lam dang de yi gegs ston la/ /kun la kun du bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnam pa bzhi zhes bgyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa yongs dag pas | | bcab pa mi mnga' bsrung med rnam gsum dang*/ /'dun dang mi 'dun bar ma gsum gyi thugs/ /nyon mongs mi 'gyur dran pa nyer gzhag gsum/ / gzhan gyi don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' dang*/ /bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa dang*/ /kun la phan dgongs thugs rje chen po dang*/ /'khrul dang ca co mnyam par ma bzhag dang*/ /dran pa nyams dang tha dad 'du shes dang*/ /ma brtags pa yis btang snyoms mi mnga' ba/ /spyod pas bsdus pa rnam pa drug dang ni/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /shes rab rnam grol ye shes ma nyams pa/ /rtogs pas bsdus pa drug dang dus gsum la/ /thogs med ye shes kyis bsdus rnam gsum dang*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi las rnams ye shes kyi/ /rjes su 'brang ba phrin las kyis bsdus pa/ /'di dag ma 'dres pa yi chos bco brgyad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la mnga' ba lags/ /gzhi lam bcas pa'i rnam pa kun mkhyen pa/ /'di dag zag med sde tshan nyi shu gcig / yon tan gyis ni yongs su bsdus pa ste/ /rtog pa chos kyi skur yang bgrang ba lags

| | las gnas gyur pa rgyal ba'i phrin las te/ /gdul bya mngon mtho'i dpal la 'god pa dang*/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nyer drangs nas/ / mthar thug sangs rgyas thob mdzad phrin las lnga/ /phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gang gsungs pa/ /thams cad 'di yi nang du 'dus mkhyen mdzod/ /de 'dra gang lags lam gyis bskrun pa'i 'bras/ /de yis rkyen dang gdul bya sna tshogs kyis | khams kyi rgyu las so so'i skal ba bzhin/ /pha mtha' yas par srid pa ji srid bar/ /sna tshogs snang bas so so'i don mdzad pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku lags te/ /skye dang bzo dang byang chub chen po dang*/ /mya ngan 'das dang sna tshogs ston pa zhes/ /sprul pa lnga ste rtogs pa phun tshogs lags/ /de lta'i thub mchog de ni chos dbyings dang*/ /ro gcig pa dang thog ma med pa yi | | sems kyi rgyud dang bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /mtha' yas rkyen las nye bar 'khrungs pa dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams rtsad nas bcom pa dang*/ / chos rnams kun la dbang 'byor brnyes pa dang*/ /smon lam dam pa nye bar grub pa dang*/ /mdzad pa'i yul yang rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir/ /rtag brtan rgyun mi 'chad pas des bstan pa'i/ /chos kyang mi nub slob pa'i dge 'dun yang*/ / rim bzhin 'byung slad 'grib par mi 'gyur bas/ /skyabs su bzung nas de 'drar mdzad du gsol/ /gsol ba 'di ni nyid kyis 'grub par bgyi/ /'di las phul gyur bgyi gzhan ma mchis la/ /bgyi ba 'di ni yongs su grub bgyis pas | | bgyir 'os bgyis pa'i rab kyi mthar phyin to/ /de ltar bstan 'di rgyal bu maṅga la'i/ /gsung gis bskul nas bskul ba po dang ni/ /skye bo gzhan gyi'ang don du 'gyur slad du/ /dge slong 'phags pa zhes byas rnam par sbyar// de lta mod kyi de yis lung gi chos/ /rgya cher ma sbyangs rtogs pa'ang ma mchis pas | | 'di yi nongs pa dam pa rnams dang ni/ /bskul ba po la bzod par gsol zhing mchis/

/dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /gnas skabs skul byed yab yum sras dang bcas/ /bsnyun med sku tshe ring zhing dge bar shog /bkra shis rmad du 'byung ba'i 'bras 'byin pas/ /rab byed 'di ni bkra shis phreng ba yin// bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes byas yang yang bskul/ /yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bgyi | | ∶mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa'i tshul gnyis gsal bar ston pa'i rab tu byed pa/ /(《 zha 》 - mngon par byed pa// ) rgyal bu maṃ ga la la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rje/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs pa'i dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ me pho byi ba'i lo bya spo'i zla ba'i tshes gcig skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i tshe/ mdo khams kyi sa'i char rdzogs par sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab ¡Ã byed ( ¡¶ zha ¡· byed pa tshigs su bcad pa rgya rtsa brgyad pa ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa/ tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mngon par mtho ba dang*/ /nges par legs pa'i tshul lugs kun/ /spyad pas srid zhi'i dpal gyur pa/ /thub dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma bskul yang ni bdag gi yid/ khyod la gzhol zhing 'bab lags na/ /bskul na smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ /de slad 'phrin 'di gleng bar bgyi | khyod kyi phun tshogs gang lags pa/ /stes dbang gis ni brnyes pa dang | | ngo bo nyid dang gnam dang ni/ /lha yis byin pa ma lags shing*/ /nyid kyi sku tshe snga ma la/ /dge ba spyad pa'i dbang dang ni/ /yab dang yum dang ma ma dang | | phan par bgyis pas bskrun pa lags/ /de slad dge la dgyes pa dang | | yab dang yum dang gnyen bshes kyi/

/byas pa drin du gzo ba dang*/ / drin la lan gyis glan par mdzod/ /mi gang brtul zhugs legs 'dzin dang*/ / rigs dang yon tan ldan pa ni/ /'dus pa'am ni re re la'ang*/ khyod kyis gus dang bkur bar bgyi/ /mgon med pa dang nad pa dang*/ /glo bur lhags dang rgan po dang*/ /dran pa nyams par gyur la sogs/ /nyam thag brtse bas bskyang bar mdzod/ /shes ldan nor gyis phongs pa dang*/ /ya rabs rgud par gyur pa dang | | log par ltung ba dag la yang*/ /brnyas par mi bgyi phan par bgyi/ / byad dang dug sbyor bgyid pa dang*/ /g.yo dang sgyu yis spyod pa dag /tshul de dag las bzlog pa'am/ /yang na ring du bskrad par mdzod/ /mi gang rig pas 'byor pa dang*/ /gzhan la phan pa lhur len dang*/ /drang po'i tshul la legs brten pa/ /ring na gnas kyang dgug par bgyi/ /sngon gyi rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims | | gna' lugs rnying pa lags mod kyang*/ /'gro la gnod 'gyur spang bgyi ste/ /phan 'gyur kun tu spel bar mdzod/ khrims su bca' ba gang lags pa | | ha cang zhib na skye bo rnams/ /shin tu gdung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ /bca' ba'ang myur du 'jig 'gyur lags/ /bcas pa snga ma snga ma rnams/ /phyi ma phyi mas sun phyung na/ /'bangs kyi ci bgyi mi 'tshal bas/ /bca' ba brtan po nyid du mdzod/ /nyung ngu'i don la mang po dang*/ /chu ngu'i don la chen po la/ /'phral gyi ched du gtan gyi don/ /yongs su nyams par mi bgyi'o/ /'di bgyi 'di las 'di 'dra'i don/ /'grub ches snyan par gang smra la/ /rang don bsgrub pa shas che bas/ /dpyod pa zhib mos dpyad par bgyi/ /rtag res 'khor dang sho gom sogs/ /ha cang bsdu ba mang gyur na/ /bzho ba mang ba'i ba bzhin du/ / skam par 'gyur ba'i dogs pa mdzod/ /bung ba yis ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /cung zad dus su sdud pa dang*/ /bsdus nas chud zos mi bgyid pa/ /'di ni legs par rnyed pa lags/ /gdug pa'i sbrul gyis mi la ltar/

/mi brtse thabs la mi mkhas pas | | dpyod pa gzhan la nyer gnod pa'i/ /rnyed pa shin tu smad pa lags/ khyod kyi sras la ji bzhin du/ /'bangs la phan pa nyer dgongs na/ /bu yis pha la ji bzhin du/ /gus pas rjed par 'gyur ba dgongs/ /byin pas dge ba rjes 'brangs bas/ /'jig rten gzhan du bde ba ste/ /spyad pa bde dang rjes 'brel bas | | 'dir ni dga' ba bskyed pa lags/ /de slad bsod nams zhing dang na | | dman pa'i zhing la dus kun tu/ /dgos pa dag dang rje mthun par/ /sa bon lhug par gdab tu gsol/ /dus dang gnas skabs mkhyen bgyis nas/ / 'tshe ba med pa'i dpal 'phel ba'i/ /longs spyod dag la bdag dang gzhan/ / dgyes rgur spyod pa lha yi tshul/ /longs spyod log par spyod pa dang*/ /mi spyod chud zos nyid 'gyur ba/ /log pa'i ∶don dang (《 zha 》 longs spyod ) don med par | | mkhyen nas nyid kyis spang bar mdzod/ /rang gi bkur sti lhag bgyid dang | | chog mi shes par longs spyod dang*/ /gzhan gyi dpal la zhe sdang ba/ / bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /gnyid kyi bde ba'i ro myang dang*/ / sgy-id lug pa la brten pa dang*/ /bre mo'i gtam la dga' ba ste/ /bya ba nyams pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /'khrig la kun du sred pa dang*/ /chang gi ro la chags pa dang | | spyod lam bag med bgyid pa ste/ /nad skyed pa yi rgyu gsum lags/ / nongs med sems can 'gum bgyid dang*/ /mi ma yin la tho 'tsham dang*/ /dus kyi cho ga'i rgyun gcod pa/ /tshe 'dzad bgyid pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /mchod 'os bkur bar mi bgyid dang*/ /mnyam pa dag la 'gran pa dang*/ /dman pa dag la brnyas pa ste/ /tshul nyams bgyid pa'i rgyu gsum lags/ /de dag rnams ni de lta bu'i/ /ngang tshul lags par mkhyen bgyis nas/ /nyid kyang de las ldog pa dang*/ /gzhan dag kyang ni zlog tu gsol/ /de yis nyid dpal 'phel ba dang | | don grub bde bar gnas pa dang*/ /tshe 'phel ba dang tshul bzhin du/

/ spyad pas bdag gzhan bde bar 'gyur/ /legs par bgyis la bya dga' dang | | nongs par spyod la chad pa yis/ /srid 'bangs 'chos par bgyid pa na | | sa skyong rnams kyi lugs lags mod/ /de tshul legs par brtag bgyi ste | | bya dga' 'tsham pa 'tsham pa yis/ /de nyid la ni sman pa dang*/ /gzhan yid mi bzod med par mdzod/ /chad pa'ang nad phyir gtar dpyad ltar/ /na smad bgyid pa rigs lags kyi/ /nad med bgyid slad gsod pa ltar/ /srog dang bral bgyid de ltar min/ /ngang tshul ngan pa'i skye bo yis/ /re zhig legs pa bgyis lags kyang*/ /ha cang gzengs bstod mi bgyi ste/ /de dang gzhan la'ang gnod pa'i rgyu/ /rang bzhin bzang po rkyen dbang gis/ /re zhig 'khrul par spyad bgyis kyang*/ /shin tu ngan (《 zha 》 na ) smad mi bgyi ste/ /de yi ngang tshul de 'dra'i phyir/ /skyes bu'i 'bad pas ma bsgrubs pa/ /rtswa dang chu la sogs pa yi | | 'tsho ba phal pas 'tsho bgyid cing*/ /'tshe ba med par gnas bgyid pa/ / bya dang ri dwags la sogs la/ /zas kyi ched du de bzhin du/ /rtse 'jo'i don du 'tshe bgyid pa/ /gna' yi lugs su gda' mod kyang*/ /rigs pa dang ni mi rigs pa/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i yid gsal ba/ khyed kyis rigs pa'i tshul brten nas/ /yang dag ci bzhin dpyad par bgyi/ /'bru dang 'bras bu sna tshogs dang*/ /'o ma zho dang lan tshwa sogs/ /bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs kyis

| | bdag nyid bde bar 'tsho bzhin du/ /bdag gi bde ba khyad bsad nas | | mang po'i dka' spyad sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gi sdig dang sdug bsngal dang | | gzhan gnod sgrub pa ga la rigs/ /de dag rnams la'ang srog phangs shing | | lus la 'tshe ba sdug bsngal ba/ /de yi dpe ni bdag nyid de/ /bdag la ji ltar gda' ba dgongs/ /mtshon chas lag brel 'jigs 'jigs 'dras// bskor bas 'bros pa'i gnas med cing*/ /rtabs pas gom pa khyor khyor po/ / 'jigs pas rig rig lta ba yi/ /gnas skabs 'di la mi brtse na/ khyod la snying rje med pa'am/ /gal te yod na gang zhig la/ /'jug par 'gyur ba gsung du gsol/ /'on kyang lugs su gyur pa'i slad/ /kun nas dgag par mi spyod na | | cha shas kyis ni spang bar bgyi/ /de tsam khyod kyis cis mi spyod/ /'jig rten dag dang bstan bcos las/ /smad dang 'tshe ba spang bgyi zhing*/ /bsngags dang phan pa gang lags pa/ /dang du bzhes shing spel du gsol/ /mdor na nyid dpal 'phel ba dang*/ /gzhan gyi dpal la mi gnod dang*/ /dpal yang dpal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra kho nar mdzad du gsol/ /srid 'bangs bde bar bgyid pa dang*/ /bde ba rgyud mar brgyud pa dang*/ /rang gi gdung brgyud rgyun brtan pa/ /lugs kyi 'bras bu de tsam lags/ /dpal mgrin rang byung 'jug sred dang*/ /lha yi bla ma yid srubs rtsen/ /lha min bla ma 'bod sgrogs sogs | | che ba'i che bar grags rnams dang*/ /ser skya gzegs zan rkang mig dang | | 'ug phrug pa la sogs pa yi/ /blo gsal rnams kyis sbyar ba dang*/ /la bgin mi sha ha dang ni/ /ma hā mad la sogs pa yi/ /log rtog rnams kyis sbyar ba'i gzhung*/ /de kun mtha' gnyis la 'chel zhing*/ /dngos dang brgyud pas rang gzhan la/ /gnod par 'gyur ba de slad du/ srid dang ngan 'gro kho na'i rgyur | | shes rab gsal ba khyod kyis ni/ /gsal bar mkhyen nas spang du gsol | | don ngan pa yi tshig legs kyang*/

/ro zhim pa yi dug bzhin du/ / gnas skabs dga' ba bskyed lags kyang*/ /phyi nas sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu/ / nang du nye bar ma zhi ba'i/ /kun spyod bzang po ston lags kyang*/ /yid rton rung ba ma lags te/ /chu skyar dang ni byi la bzhin/ /srid pa'i rtsa ba m-i gcod pa'i/ / gnas skabs zhi bar bgyid lags kyang*/ /nges par 'byung ba ma lags te/ / tsha ba'i rim la chu grang bzhin/ /de slad yang srid sun 'byin zhing*/ /thar pa dam pa thob bgyid pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa kho na'i gsung*/ /de yang dge ba'i bshes las btsal/ /tshul khrims phung pos sku dul zhing*/ /mang du gsan pas gsung yang dag /ting nge 'dzin gyis thugs zhi la/ /brtse bas sems can rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen bshes kyi dam pa ste/ /de 'dra gang na su bzhugs kyang*/ /de la sangs rgyas nyid ji bzhin/ /shin tu gus pas bsten par bgyi/ /de las yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /bsnyen gnas blangs nas bsrung bar mdzod/ /de tsam gyis kyang 'dod lha'i dpal/ /thob par 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /gzhan yang ji ltar nus pa yi/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa yis/ khyod kyi brtul zhugs mdzes par mdzod/ /de ni lam rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /theg pa che la ma gtogs par/ /thar pa chen po mi 'thob pas/ khyod thugs theg pa chen po la/ /kun nas gzhol zhing goms par mdzod/ /gang la skyabs na bslu 'gyur ba'i/ /yul de skyabs gnas ma lags pas/ /lha dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i | | chen po'ang 'dir ni mchod bya tsam/ /'phags pa rang rgyal la sogs pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 102PAGE 101
